content: Saulo owuo akyi no, Dawid sane firii nkonim a ɔdii Amalekfoɔ so no mu bɛtenaa Siklag nnanu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ne nnansa so no, ɔbarima bi firi Saulo sraban mu a watete ne ntadeɛ mu, atu mfuturo agu ne tiri mu, de rekyerɛ sɛ ɔretwa adwo baeɛ. Ɔduruu Dawid nkyɛn no, ɔdanee ne ho hwee fam anidie mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Dawid bisaa no sɛ, “Ɛhe na wofiri?”
    Ɔbuaa sɛ, “Madwane afiri Israel sraban mu.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Dawid bisaa no sɛ, “Na ɛyɛɛ dɛn? Ɔko no kɔsii sɛn?”
    Ɔkaa sɛ, “Mmarima no dwane firii akono. Bebree totɔeɛ. Na Saulo ne ne babarima Yonatan nso atotɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Enti, Dawid bisaa aberanteɛ a ɔbɛbɔɔ no saa amaneɛ no sɛ, “Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wohunuu sɛ Saulo ne ne babarima Yonatan awuwu?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Aberanteɛ no buaa sɛ, “Mekɔfirii Gilboa bepɔ so, na mekɔtoo sɛ Saulo sina ne pea so a atamfoɔ no nteaseɛnam ne nʼapɔnkɔsotefoɔ abɛn no ara.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɔdanee ne ho a ɔhunuu me no, ɔteaam frɛɛ me sɛ memmra. Mebisaa no sɛ, ‘Menyɛ ɛdeɛn?’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
“Ɔbisaa me sɛ, ‘Wone hwan?’
    “Mebuaa no sɛ, ‘Meyɛ Amalekni.’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: “Na ɔsrɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Bɛgyina me so na kum me, na me ho yera me yie, na mepɛ sɛ mewu.’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: “Enti, megyinaa ne so kumm no, ɛfiri sɛ, na menim sɛ tebea a ɔwɔ mu no, ɔrennya nkwa. Na metuu nʼahenkyɛ a ɛhyɛ no no ne nʼabasa so kapo no sɛ mede rebrɛ wo, me wura.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Dawid ne ne mmarima no tee asɛm no, wɔde awerɛhoɔ sunsuanee wɔn ntadeɛ mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Wɔtwaa ho agyaadwoɔ, suiɛ, bua daa da mu no nyinaa wɔ Saulo ne ne babarima Yonatan wuo ne Awurade akodɔm ne Israelman sɛ wɔn mu pii wuwuu saa da no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Na Dawid bisaa aberanteɛ a ɔbɛbɔɔ wɔn saa amaneɛ no sɛ, “Wofiri he?”
    Na ɔbuaa sɛ, “Meyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ Amalekni a mete mo asase so.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Dawid bisaa no sɛ, “Na wonsuro sɛ wobɛkum obi a Awurade asra no no?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ne mmarima no mu baako sɛ, “Ku no!” Enti, ɔbarima no twee nʼakofena de wɔɔ Amalekni no, kumm no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Dawid kaa sɛ, “Wʼano ayi mmusuo ama wo ama woawu, ɛfiri sɛ, wo ara na wokaa sɛ woakum obi a Awurade asra no no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Dawid too kwadwom maa Saulo ne Yonatan.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔnkyerɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ Yuda nyinaa to. Wɔtoo no edin sɛ agyan dwom a wɔatwerɛ wɔ Yasar Nwoma mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
“Wʼanimuonyam ne wʼahosɛpɛ, Ao Israel, awu da mmepɔ so!
    Akofoɔ akɛseɛ atotɔ!

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
“Monnka asɛm yi wɔ Gat,
    na Filistifoɔ abɔ ose!
  Monnka wɔ Askelon mmɔntene so,
    na abosonsomfoɔ ansere ahosɛpɛ mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
“Ao Gilboa mmepɔ,
    mma bosuo anaa osuo ntɔ ngu wo so,
    anaa wo nsianeɛ so.
  Ɛfiri sɛ, ɛhɔ na wɔguu ɔkofoɔ kɛseɛ no akokyɛm ho fi;
    wɔremfa ngo nsra Saulo akokyɛm ho bio.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
“Saulo ne Yonatan kunkumm wɔn atamfoɔ ahoɔdenfoɔ!
    Wɔamfiri akono amma no nsapan.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Ɔdɔ ne ahoɔfɛ bɛn
    na na Saulo ne Yonatan nni,
    wɔn mu antete da, nkwa ne owuo mu.
  Na wɔn ho yɛ hare kyɛn akɔdeɛ;
    na wɔn ho yɛ den kyɛn agyata.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
“Ao, Israel mmaa,
    monsu Saulo,
  ɛfiri sɛ, ɔfiraa mo ntoma pa,
    hyehyɛɛ mo sikakɔkɔɔ agudeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
“Akofoɔ akɛseɛ atotɔ akono.
    Yonatan awu da mmepɔ no so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39
Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
“Hwɛ sɛdeɛ akofoɔ akɛseɛ atotɔ!
    Wɔayiyi wɔn akodeɛ afiri wɔn ho, na wɔawuwu deda hɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Akyire no, Amonhene Nahas wuiɛ. Ne babarima Hanun na ɔdii nʼadeɛ sɛ ɔhene.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content:
Dawid kaa sɛ, “Mɛyɛ Nahas babarima Hanun adɔeɛ, sɛdeɛ nʼagya yɛɛ me adɔeɛ no.” Nʼagya wuo enti, Dawid tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ ne nkyɛn kɔmaa no hyɛden.
    Ɛberɛ a Dawid abɔfoɔ baa Amonfoɔ asase so no,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Amonfoɔ atitire no kɔbisaa wɔn wura Hanun sɛ, “Wogye di sɛ ba a Dawid somaa nʼabɔfoɔ baa wo nkyɛn bɛmaa wo hyɛden no kyerɛ anidie ampa ara anaa? Wonnye nni sɛ Dawid somaa wɔn akwansra so, sɛ wɔmmɛhwɛ wo kuropɔn na wɔabɛtu agu?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛno enti, Hanun kyeree Dawid abɔfoɔ no, yii obiara abɔgyesɛ fa, twitwaa wɔn ntadeɛ to mfimfini hɔ, tutuu mu, na wɔgyaa wɔn ɛkwan, maa wɔde animguaseɛ kɔeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛberɛ a wɔbɔɔ Dawid amaneɛ no, ɔtuu abɔfoɔ ma wɔkɔhyiaa mmarima no, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔguu wɔn anim ase yie. Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, “Montena Yeriko kɔsi sɛ mo abɔgyesɛ bɛfu ansa na moasane aba.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛberɛ a Amonfoɔ hunuu sɛ wɔahyɛ Dawid abufuo no, wɔkɔbɔɔ Aramfoɔ asraafoɔ ɔpeduonu paa firii Bet-Rehob ne Soba. Saa ara na Maakahene nso maa wɔn mmarima apem firii ne nkyɛn, na Tob nso wɔnyaa mmarima mpem dumienu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛberɛ a Dawid tee saa asɛm yi no, ɔsomaa Yoab ne nʼakofoɔ sɛ wɔne wɔn nkɔko.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Amonfoɔ no gyinaa wɔn kuro no ɛpono ano. Saa ɛberɛ no na Aramfoɔ a wɔfiri Soba ne Rehob ne mmarima a wɔfiri Tob ne Maaka no wɔ mfikyire baabiara retwɛn ɔtamfoɔ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛberɛ a Yoab hunuu sɛ ɔbɛko akofanu no, ɔyii akodɔm a wɔyɛ nnam. Ɔno ara dii wɔn so safohene, dii wɔn anim, kɔko tiaa Aramfoɔ no wɔ mfikyire hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɔgyaa akodɔm a wɔaka no maa ne nuabarima Abisai sɛ ɔnkɔto nhyɛ Amonfoɔ no so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Yoab ka kyerɛɛ ne nuabarima no sɛ, “Sɛ Aramfoɔ no yɛ den dodo ma me a, ɛyɛ a, bɛboa me. Na sɛ Amonfoɔ no nso yɛ den dodo ma wo a, me nso, mɛba abɛboa wo.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Hyɛ wo ho den. Ma yɛmfa akokoɔduru nko nnye yɛn nkurɔfoɔ ne yɛn Onyankopɔn nkuro. Awurade pɛ nyɛ hɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛberɛ a Yoab ne nʼakodɔm to hyɛɛ Aramfoɔ no so no, wɔhyɛɛ aseɛ dwaneeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Na Amonfoɔ no hunuu sɛ Aramfoɔ no redwane no, wɔdwane firii Abisai ho kɔhyɛɛ kuro no mu. Ɔko no guiɛ no, Yoab sane kɔɔ Yerusalem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Afei, Aramfoɔ no hunuu sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn afɛ ne Israelfoɔ. Enti, wɔboaa wɔn ho ano bio no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Aram akodɔm foforɔ bi bɛkaa wɔn ho a Hadadeser na ɔsoma ma wɔkɔfaa wɔn firii Asubɔnten Eufrate fa nohoa baeɛ. Saa akodɔm yi bɛduruu Helam a Sobak na na ɔyɛ wɔn ɔsahene, na ɔyɛ ɔsahene a ɔtua Hadadeser akodɔm nyinaa ano nso.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛberɛ a Dawid tee deɛ ɛreba no, ɔboaboaa Israel nyinaa ano, de wɔn twaa Asubɔnten Yordan, dii akodɔm no anim, kɔduruu Helam. Ɛhɔ na Aramfoɔ no fifirii wɔn mpasua so to hyɛɛ Dawid so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Nanso, bio, Aramfoɔ no dwane firii Israelfoɔ no anim. Saa ɛberɛ yi, Dawid akodɔm no kunkumm nteaseɛnamkafoɔ ahanson ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mpem aduanan a Sobak a na ɔyɛ wɔn sahene no ka ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content:
Hadadeser ne nʼadɔmfoɔ Aramfoɔ hunuu sɛ Israel adi wɔn so nkonim no, wɔmaa wɔn nsa so, na wɔbɛyɛɛ Israelfoɔ nkoa.
    Ɛno akyi, Aramfoɔ suroo sɛ wɔbɛboa Amonfoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Osutɔberɛ a ɛdi soɔ no mu, ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ ahemfo kɔ ɔsa no, Dawid somaa Yoab ne Israel akodɔm nyinaa sɛ wɔnkɔsɛe Amonfoɔ. Wɔkɔtuaa kuropɔn Raba, na Dawid deɛ, ɔkaa Yerusalem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛda bi anwummerɛ a Dawid ayi nʼani so kakra no, ɔsɔre firii ne mpa so nante faa nʼahemfie no atifi. Ɔgyina hɔ no, ɔhunuu ɔbaa bi sɛ ɔredware. Na ɔbaa no ho yɛ fɛ yie,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: na Dawid somaa obi sɛ ɔnkɔbisa ne ho nsɛm. Ɔbarima no bɛkaa sɛ, “Ɛyɛ Eliam babaa Batseba, a ɔyɛ Hetini Uria yere.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Na Dawid tuu abɔfoɔ sɛ wɔnkɔfrɛ no mmrɛ no. Ɔbaa Dawid nkyɛn. Dawid ne no daeɛ. (Ɔdwiraa ne ho firii ne nsabuo mu no, na ɛnkyɛreɛ.) Afei, ɔsane kɔɔ efie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛberɛ a Batseba hunuu sɛ wanyinsɛn no, ɔsoma maa wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Enti, Dawid soma kɔɔ Yoab nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Fa Hetini Uria brɛ me.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛberɛ a Uria duruu Dawid nkyɛn no, ɔbisaa gyinaberɛ a Yoab ne akodɔm no wɔ mu ne sɛdeɛ ɔko no rekɔ so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Uria sɛ, “Kɔ efie na kɔhome.” Na mpo, Uria firii ahemfie hɔ no, Dawid soma maa wɔde akyɛdeɛ bi kɔmaa no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Nanso, Uria ankɔ fie. Ɔne ɔhene asomfoɔ no bi tenaa ahemfie ɛpono no ano.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛberɛ a Dawid tee deɛ Uria ayɛ no, ɔfrɛɛ no bisaa no sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn na ɛha wo? Wofirii fie akyɛre na adɛn na woankɔ hɔ ɛnnora anadwo?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Uria buaa sɛ, “Apam Adaka no ne Israel akodɔm ne Yuda tete ntomadan mu, ɛnna Yoab nso ne ne mpanimfoɔ abɔ atenaeɛ wɔ wiram baabi petee mu. Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matumi akɔ efie akɔnom nsã, adidi na me ne me yere akɔda? Meka ntam sɛ merenyɛ yei na madi ho fɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Ɛyɛ, tena ha anadwo yi, na ɔkyena wobɛkɔ akodɔm no mu.” Enti, Uria tenaa Yerusalem ɛda no ne nʼadekyeeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Na Dawid frɛɛ no anadwoduane apontoɔ, na ɔmaa no nsã ma ɔboroeɛ. Na ɛno mpo, Uria ankɔ efie ankɔhunu ne yere. Ɔdaa ahemfie no ɛkwan ano bio.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Adeɛ kyee anɔpa no, Dawid twerɛɛ krataa maa Uria sɛ ɔmfa nkɔma Yoab.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Krataa no mu nsɛm kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ, “Ma Uria nkɔ akono baabi a ɔko no ano yɛ den pa ara. Wo deɛ, sane wʼakyi, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, wɔbɛkum no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Enti, Yoab maa Uria kɔgyinaa baabi a ɛbɛn kuro no fasuo, a ɛhɔ na ɔnim sɛ atamfoɔ no mmarima a wɔyɛ den no reko.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛhɔ na wɔkumm Hetini Uria ne Israel asraafoɔ no bebree.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Na Yoab de ɔsa mu amaneɛ kɔbɔɔ Dawid.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɔka kyerɛɛ nʼabɔfoɔ no sɛ, “Monka ɔsa mu nsɛm no nyinaa nkyerɛ ɔhene.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Nanso, ebia ne bo bɛfu, ama wabisa sɛ, ‘Adɛn enti na akodɔm no kɔbɛn kuro no pɛɛ saa? Na wɔnnim sɛ wɔbɛto agyan afiri afasuo no mu?

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɔbaabasia anto ayuyammoɔ ammɔ Gideon babarima Abimelek wɔ Tebes ankum no?’ Afei, monka nkyerɛ no sɛ, wɔakum Hetini Uria nso.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Enti, abɔfoɔ no kɔɔ Yerusalem kɔbɔɔ ɔsa no mu amaneɛ kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛdeɛ Yoab somaa no sɛ ɔnkɔka.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Abɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ, “Mmarima no bu faa yɛn so, na wɔtiaa yɛn petee mu deɛ, nanso yɛpiaa wɔn kɔɔ kuro no ɛpono ano.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛhɔ na agyantofoɔ too wʼasomfoɔ firii ɔfasuo ho, maa ɔhene mmarima no bi wuwuiɛ. Na wo ɔsomfoɔ Hetini Uria nso awu.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Dawid ka kyerɛɛ abɔfoɔ no sɛ, “Ɛyɛ, Monka nkyerɛ Yoab sɛ ɔmmma nʼaba mu mmu, na ɔko mu deɛ obiara tumi wu. Monyere mo ho nko ɔkoden na monni kuropɔn no so nkonim.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Ɛberɛ a Batseba tee sɛ ne kunu awuo no, ɔsuu no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Na osu no akyi no, Dawid soma ma wɔkɔfaa no baa ne fie. Ɔbɛyɛɛ ne yere, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima. Na deɛ Dawid yɛeɛ no ansɔ Awurade ani.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-11:27

content: Awurade somaa odiyifoɔ Natan sɛ ɔnkɔka abasɛm yi nkyerɛ Dawid: “Na mmarima baanu bi te kuro bi so. Na mmarima no mu baako yɛ osikani, na deɛ ɔka ho no nso yɛ ohiani.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Na osikani no wɔ nnwan ne anantwie bebree,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: ohiani no deɛ, na ɔnni hwee ka odwanbereɛ ketewa bi a ɔtɔɔ no ho. Ɔyɛn no maa ɔne ɔno ankasa mma nyini boom. Na ɔne aboa no di nʼaduane, nom firi ne kuruwa mu, na nna mu nso, na daa ɔda nʼabasa so. Na ɔte sɛ ɔbabaa ma no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: “Ɛda koro bi, ɔhɔhoɔ bi baa osikani no nkyɛn, nanso wankum ne nnwan anaa ne nantwie annoa aduane amfa ansom no hɔhoɔ. Na mmom, ɔkɔkyeree ohiani no odwanbereɛ no, de yɛɛ aduane maa ɔhɔhoɔ a wabɛsoɛ no no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Dawid tee asɛm no, ne bo fuu saa ɔbarima no yie, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Natan sɛ, “Mmerɛ dodoɔ a Awurade te ase yi, ɛfata sɛ ɔbarima a ɔyɛɛ saa no wuo.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtua odwanbereɛ no ka mmɔ ho ɛnan sɛ ɔyɛɛ bɔne saa a wannya ahummɔborɔ biara.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Ɛhɔ ara, Natan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ, “Wone saa ɔbarima no! Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn, se, ‘Mesraa wo sɛ Israelhene, gyee wo firii Saulo tumi ase.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Mede ne fie ne ne yerenom ne Israel ne Yuda ahemman maa wo. Na sɛ na ɛnonom nnɔɔso a, anka mɛma wo bebree aka ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Adɛn enti na woabu Awurade asɛm animtia, na woayɛ bɔne a ɛte saa? Woakum Hetini Uria, awia ne yere.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Ɛfiri ɛnnɛ rekorɔ, akofena na ɛbɛyɛ ahunahunadeɛ ama wo fiefoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ, woabu me animtia, afa Hetini Uria yere de no ayɛ wo yere.’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: “Esiane deɛ woayɛ yi enti, me Awurade, mɛma wʼankasa fidua mufoɔ asɔre atia wo. Mede wo yerenom bɛma ɔbarima foforɔ, na ɔne wɔn bɛda ama obiara ahunu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Woyɛɛ yei wɔ kɔkoam, nanso mɛma deɛ ɛreba wo so no ada dwa, ama Israel nyinaa ahunu.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content:
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Natan sɛ, “Mayɛ bɔne atia Awurade.”
    Natan buaa sɛ, “Awurade ayi wo bɔne no afiri wo so. Worenwu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Nanso, sɛ woama Awurade atamfoɔ ɛkwan sɛ wɔmmu no animtia, ngu ne din ho fi enti, ɔba a wɔbɛwo no ama wo no bɛwu.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Natan kɔɔ ne fie ara pɛ, Awurade maa abɔfra a Uria yere Batseba wo maa Dawid no yaree dendeenden.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Dawid srɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ ɔmma abɔfra no nkye. Ɔkyenee ho kɔm, na ɔkɔɔ fie, na anadwo mu no nyinaa, ɔdaa fam tim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Mpanimfoɔ a wɔwɔ ne fie srɛɛ no sɛ ɔnsɔre na ɔne wɔn nnidi, nanso wampene.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Ne nnanson so, abɔfra no wuiɛ. Na Dawid afotufoɔ no suro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ no amaneɛ sɛ abɔfra no awu, ɛfiri sɛ, na wɔn adwene ne sɛ, “Ɛberɛ a na abɔfra no te ase no, yɛkasa kyerɛɛ Dawid, nanso wantie yɛn. Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛatumi aka akyerɛ no sɛ abɔfra no awu? Anhwɛ a, ɔbɛyɛ ne ho biribi.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content:
Na Dawid hunuu sɛ nʼafotufoɔ no reyɛ huhuhuhu no, ɔtee nka sɛ abɔfra no awu. Ɔbisaa sɛ, “Abɔfra no awu anaa?”
    Wɔbuaa sɛ, “Aane, wawu.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Na Dawid sɔre firii fam hɔ. Afei, ɔdware wieeɛ a ɔpetee ne ho aduhwam, na ɔsesaa ne ntadeɛ no, ɔkɔɔ Awurade efie kɔsomee. Afei, ɔkɔɔ nʼankasa efie, na ɔno ankasa bisa ma wɔbrɛɛ no aduane, na ɔdidiiɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Nʼafotufoɔ no bisaa no sɛ, “Deɛ woreyɛ yi, aseɛ ne sɛn? Ɛberɛ a abɔfra no te ase no, wodii mmuada, twaa agyaadwoɔ. Na afei a wawu no mmom na woasɔre adidie!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Ɔbuaa sɛ, “Ɛberɛ a na abɔfra no da so te ase no deɛ, medii abuada, twaa agyaadwoɔ. Medwenee sɛ, ‘Hwan na ɔnim? Ebia, Awurade bɛhunu me mmɔbɔ ama abɔfra no atena.’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Na afei a wawu yi, adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ medi abuada? Mɛtumi asane de no aba nkwa mu bio anaa? Mɛkɔ ne nkyɛn da bi, na ɔno deɛ, ɔrensane mma me nkyɛn ha da.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Na Dawid kyekyeree ne yere Batseba werɛ, na ɔne no daeɛ. Ɔnyinsɛneeɛ, woo ɔbabarima, na wɔtoo no edin Salomo. Awurade pɛɛ abɔfra no asɛm,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: na ɔde asɛm faa odiyifoɔ Natan so sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ abɔfra no din yɛ Yedidia, ɛfiri sɛ na Awurade dɔ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Saa ɛberɛ no, na Yoab ne Israel akodɔm no reyɛ awie Amon ahenkuro Raba tua no nkonimdie so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Yoab somaa abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn, kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Mako atia Raba, afa deɛ wɔnya wɔn nsuo firie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Afei, fa akodɔm a wɔaka no bra na wɔnwie adwuma no, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, wobɛnya nkonimdie animuonyam no sene sɛ ɛbɛyɛ me dea.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Enti, Dawid dii nʼakodɔm a wɔaka no anim kɔɔ Raba kɔfaa hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Dawid tuu ɔhene no ahenkyɛ, na nnipa no de hyɛɛ Dawid. Wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ na ɛyɛɛ ahenkyɛ no a aboɔdemmoɔ bobɔ mu. Na emu duru yɛ kilogram aduasa ɛnan. Dawid foo asadeɛ bebree wɔ kuropɔn no mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Ɔsane faa nnipa a wɔwɔ Raba no sɛ nkoa, hyɛɛ wɔn, ma wɔde ɛwan, pinkase ne nkuma yɛɛ adwuma wɔ ntayaa fononoo ho. Saa ara na ɔne nnipa a wɔwɔ Amon nkuro nyinaa so dii noɔ. Na Dawid ne nʼakodɔm sane kɔɔ Yerusalem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11:27-12:31

content: Na Dawid babarima Absalom wɔ nuabaa bi a na ne ho yɛ fɛ yie. Na saa ɔbaa no din de Tamar. Na Amnon a ɔyɛ ne nuabarima no kɔn dɔɔ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Amnon tuu nʼani sii Tamar so ara kɔsii sɛ ɛbɔɔ no yadeɛ. Na ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu enti, na Amnon susu sɛ ne dɔ no nkɔsi hwee.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na Amnon wɔ adamfo oniferefoɔ bi a wɔfrɛ no Yonadab. Na ɔyɛ Dawid nuabarima Simea babarima.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɛda koro bi, Yonadab bisaa Amnon sɛ, “Asɛm bɛn na aba? Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhene babarima yɛ bosaa anɔpa biara saa?” Na Amnon buaa no sɛ, “Medɔ Tamar, Absalom nuabaa no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Yonadab kaa sɛ, “Ɛyɛ, mɛkyerɛ wo deɛ wobɛyɛ. Sane kɔ na kɔda wo mpa so, na hyɛ da yɛ sɛ deɛ woyare no. Sɛ wʼagya bɛhunu wo a, ka kyerɛ no sɛ ɔnka nkyerɛ Tamar, na ɔmmɛyɛ aduane bi mma wo nni. Ka kyerɛ no sɛ, sɛ ɔno brɛ wo aduane di a, wo ho bɛtɔ wo.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Enti, Amnon boapa yareeɛ. Na ɔhene no bɛsraa no no, Amnon ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Mesrɛ wo, ma Tamar mmɛhwɛ me, na ɔnnoa biribi mma menni.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Dawid penee so, somaa Tamar kɔɔ Amnon fie, kɔnoaa aduane maa no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɛberɛ a Tamar duruu Amnon efie hɔ no, ɔkɔɔ ɛdan a na ɔda mu no mu, sɛdeɛ sɛ Tamar refotɔ asikyiresiam a ɔbɛhunu. Enti, ɔtoo burodo sononko bi maa no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Nanso, ɔde aduane no guu apaawa so bɛsii nʼanim no, wampɛ sɛ ɔdi. Na Amnon ka kyerɛɛ nʼasomfoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ no sɛ, “Obiara mfiri ha nkɔ!” Enti, wɔn nyinaa kɔeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Afei, ɔka kyerɛɛ Tamar sɛ, “Fa aduane no brɛ me wɔ me pia mu, na bubu hyɛ mʼano.” Enti, Tamar maa so de kɔɔ hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na ɛberɛ a ɔgu so de rema no no, ɔto hyɛɛ ne so, na ɔkaa sɛ, “Wo ne me nna, me nuabaa ɔdɔfoɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na Tamar teaam sɛ, “Dabi, onua barima! Nni saa nkwaseasɛm no! Ɛnyɛ me saa! Wonim sɛ, sɛ woyɛ a, ɛyɛ bɔne kɛseɛ wɔ Israel.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na ɛhe na anka mede saa aniwuo no bɛfa? Na wɔbɛka sɛ, wo nso woyɛ nkwaseafoɔ akɛseɛ a wɔwɔ Israel no mu baako. Mesrɛ wo, ka biribi kɛkɛ kyerɛ ɔhene, na ɔbɛma woaware me.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Nanso, Amnon ampene so. Na ɛsiane sɛ ɔwɔ ahoɔden sene Tamar enti, ɔtoo no monnaa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɛhɔ ara, Amnon dɔ no danee ɔtan. Ɔtan no mu yɛɛ den sen ɔdɔ a na ɔdɔ no no. Ɔteateaam sɛ, “Firi ha kɔ ntɛm!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content:
Tamar nso teateaam sɛ, “Dabi. Sɛ worepam me afiri ha seesei no yɛ bɔne kɛseɛ koraa sene deɛ woayɛ me dada no.”
    Nanso, Amnon ampɛ sɛ ɔbɛtie no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɔteaam frɛɛ ne ɔsomfoɔ hyɛɛ no sɛ, “Pam saa ɔbaa yi firi ha, na to ɛpono no mu!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Enti, ɔsomfoɔ no pamoo no. Na ɔhyɛ batakari tenten fɛfɛ bi sɛdeɛ na amanneɛ kyerɛ wɔ ɔhene babaa a ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu ho no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Nanso, Tamar sunsuanee ne batakari no mu, de nsõ guu ne tiri mu. Afei, ɔde ne nsa kataa nʼani, de esu sii ɛkwan so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ne nuabarima Absalom hunuu no bisaa no sɛ, “Wo nuabarima Amnon ne wo ada anaa? Yɛ dinn, me nuabaa; ɔyɛ wo nuabarima. Mfa saa asɛm yi nhyɛ wʼakoma mu.” Na Tamar tenaa ase sɛ ankonam werɛhoni baa wɔ Absalom fie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɛberɛ a ɔhene Dawid tee asɛm yi no, ne bo fuu yie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Absalom nso anka ho hwee ankyerɛ Amnon. Nanso, ɔtan Amnon yie, ɛfiri sɛ, wagu ne nuabaa Tamar anim ase.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Mfeɛ mmienu akyi, ɛda koro bi a na wɔretwitwa Absalom nnwan ho nwi wɔ Baal-Hasor a ɛbɛn Efraim hyeɛ so no, Absalom too nsa frɛɛ ɔhene mmammarima nyinaa sɛ wɔmmra hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Absalom kɔɔ ɔhene nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Me nnwan nwitwitwafoɔ reyɛ adwuma. Ɔhene ne nʼasomfoɔ bɛba abɛka me ho anaa?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɔhene buaa sɛ, “Dabi, me ba. Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛn nyinaa kɔ; yɛbɛyɛ ɔhaw ama wo.” Ɛwom sɛ Absalom hyɛɛ no deɛ, nanso wampene sɛ ɔbɛkorɔ, na ɔhyiraa no kosɛkosɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content:
Na Absalom kaa sɛ, “Sɛ saa na ɛte deɛ a, ma me nuabarima Amnon mmɛka yɛn ho.”
    Ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ, “Adɛn enti na wobisa Amnon?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Nanso, ɔhyɛɛ no enti, ɔmaa Amnon ne ahenemma no nyinaa bɛkaa ne ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Absalom ka kyerɛɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ no sɛ, “Montie! Montwɛn na Amnon mmoro nsã, na afei mɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ na moakum no. Monnsuro. Me ara na mahyɛ mo sɛ monyɛ saa. Momfa akokoɔduru nyɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Enti, Absalom mmarima no yɛɛ Amnon saa, sɛdeɛ Absalom hyɛɛ wɔn no. Afei, ahene mmammarima no nyinaa sɔre tenatenaa wɔn mfunumu so, na wɔdwaneeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɛberɛ a wɔresane akɔ Yerusalem no, saa asɛm yi duruu Dawid asom sɛ, “Absalom akunkum wo mmammarima no nyinaa a anka ɔbaako koraa.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɔhene no huri sii fam, sunsuanee nʼatadeɛ mu, daa fam. Nʼafotufoɔ nyinaa de ahodwirie ne awerɛhoɔ sunsuanee wɔn ntadeɛ mu, dedaa fam saa ara.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Nanso, ankyɛre biara na Yonadab a ɔyɛ Dawid nuabarima Simea babarima no bɛduruu hɔ kaa sɛ, “Dabi, ɛnte saa. Ɛnyɛ wo mma no nyinaa na wɔakunkum wɔn. Amnon nko ara na wɔakum no. Ɛfiri ɛberɛ a Amnon too ne nuabaa Tamar monnaa no, na Absalom yɛɛ nʼadwene saa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Dabi, wo mma no nyinaa nwuwuiɛ saa. Ɛyɛ Amnon nko ara.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content:
Saa ɛberɛ no, na Absalom adwane.
    Ɔwɛmfoɔ a ɔwɔ Yerusalem ɔfasuo so no hunuu sɛ ɛdɔm kɛseɛ firi atɔeɛ fam reba kuro no mu. Ɔtuu mmirika kɔbɔɔ ɔhene amaneɛ sɛ, “Mahunu sɛ ɛdɔm firi Horonaim ɛkwan a ɛda bepɔ no nkyɛn mu hɔ no so reba.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Yonadab ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ, “Wɔn na wɔreba no! Wo mma no reba sɛdeɛ mekaeɛ no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ankyɛre na wɔbɛduruiɛ a, wɔretwa adwo, te anisuo, na ɔhene ne ne mpanimfoɔ nso twaa agyaadwoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na Dawid suu ne babarima Amnon nna bebree. Na Absalom dwane kɔɔ ne nana barima Talmai a na ɔyɛ Amihud a na ɔyɛ ɔhene Gesur no babarima nkyɛn.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɔkɔtenaa Gesur hɔ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na Dawid a afei wagyae Amnon wuo no ho asɛm no pɛɛ sɛ ɔne ne babarima Absalom sane ka bom.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na Yoab hunuu sɛ ɔhene pɛ sɛ ɔhunu Absalom.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Enti, ɔsoma ma wɔkɔɔ Tekoa kɔfaa ɔbaa nyansafoɔ bi a wagye edin yie brɛɛ no. Yoab ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Hyɛ da yɛ wo ho sɛ wowɔ ayie mu, na fira ayitoma. Nnware anaa mfa aduhwam mpete wo ho nso. Yɛ wo ho sɛ ɔbaa a wadi awerɛhoɔ nna bebree.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na kɔ ɔhene nkyɛn kɔka asɛm a merebɛka akyerɛ wo yi kyerɛ no.” Na Yoab kaa asɛm a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbaa no kɔka no kyerɛɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na Tekoani baa no duruu ɔhene no anim no, ɔhwee fam de nʼanim butuu fam teaam sɛ, “Ao Nana! Boa me!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content:
Ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ, “Ɛyɛ asɛm bɛn?”
    Ɔbuaa no sɛ, “Meyɛ okunafoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Me mma baanu kɔdii ako wɔ akono. Na ɛsiane sɛ na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛpata ɔko no enti, wɔkumm wɔn mu baako.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Nanso, abusua no nkaeɛ no bisaa sɛ, ‘Ma yɛn nsa nka wo ba no. Yɛbɛkum no, ɛfiri sɛ, woakum ne nuabarima. Ɔmfata sɛ ɔbɛdi efie agyapadeɛ so.’ Na sɛ meyɛ saa nso a, na menni obiara a waka, na me kunu din ne me fie bɛyera wɔ asase so ha.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Gyae asɛm no ma me. Kɔ efie na mɛhwɛ sɛ obiara remfa ne nsa nka no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɔkaa sɛ, “Ao, me wura, meda wo ase. Na sɛ mmoa a woaboa me yi enti, sɛ obi kasa tia wo a, mɛfa ho soboɔ no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɔhene no kaa sɛ, “Mma yei nha wo. Sɛ nnipa bi mpene a, fa wɔn brɛ me wɔ ha. Na mɛtumi ama wo awerɛhyɛmu sɛ, obiara nwiinwii wɔ ho bio.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content:
Afei, ɔbaa no kaa sɛ, “Fa Awurade, wo Onyankopɔn, no din ka ntam kyerɛ me sɛ, woremma obiara ntɔ me babarima no so were. Merenhwehwɛ mogyahwieguo bio.”
    Ɔhene no nso kaa sɛ, “Mmerɛ dodoɔ a Awurade te ase yi, wo ba no tirinwi a ɛwɔ ne tiri so mu baako mpo ho renka.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content:
Afei, ɔbaa no kaa sɛ, “Ma wo ɔsomfoɔ nka biribi nkyerɛ me wura ɔhene.”
    Ɔbuaa sɛ, “Kɔ so kasa.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɔbaa no bisaa sɛ, “Adɛn enti na wonyɛ mma Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔahyɛ bɔ sɛ wobɛyɛ ama me no. Woabu wo ho fɔ sɛ woasi saa gyinaeɛ yi. Wompɛ sɛ woma wʼankasa wo ba a wɔatwa no asuo no ba efie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Sɛ ɛkɔsi sɛn ara, obiara bɛwu. Na sɛdeɛ nsuo hwie gu fam a wosesa a ɛnyɛ yie no, saa ara na nkwa teɛ. Ɛno enti na Onyankopɔn sane de yɛn ba ne nkyɛn ɛberɛ a yɛate yɛn ho afiri ne ho no. Wɔn a ɔhwɛ wɔn no, ɔmma wɔnnhwere wɔn kra; enti wo nso, ɛnsɛ sɛ woyɛ saa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: “Na maba sɛ merebɛdi ama me babarima, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔde owuo hunahuna me ne me ba no. Meka kyerɛɛ me ho sɛ, ‘Ebia, ɔhene bɛtie me,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: na wagye yɛn afiri wɔn a wɔbɛtwa yɛn afiri Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ ho no nsam.’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: “Aane, ɔhene no bɛma yɛn asomdwoeɛ bio. ‘Menim sɛ wote sɛ Onyankopɔn ɔbɔfoɔ a wobɛtumi ahunu papa ne bɔne ntam nsonsonoeɛ. Awurade, wo Onyankopɔn, nka wo ho.’ ”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content:
Ɔhene bisaa sɛ, “Mepɛ sɛ mehunu adeɛ baako.”
    Ɔbaa no kaa sɛ, “Ɛyɛ ɛdeɛn, me wura?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content:
Na ɔhene no bisaa sɛ, “Yoab na ɔsomaa wo ha anaa?”
    Ɔbaa no buaa sɛ, “Me wura, Daasebrɛ, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matwa yei ho atorɔ? Obiara ntumi mfa biribiara nhinta wo. Ɛyɛ nokorɛ sɛ Yoab na ɔsomaa me, na ɔkyerɛɛ me asɛm a menka.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɔyɛɛ saa, sɛdeɛ mɛfa ɛkwan foforɔ so de saa asɛm yi ato wʼanim. Na wo nso, wonim nyansa te sɛ Onyankopɔn ɔbɔfoɔ, na biribiara a ɛsi yɛn ntam ha no nso, wote aseɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Enti, ɔhene no soma ma wɔkɔfaa Yoab baeɛ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Ɛyɛ, kɔ na kɔfa aberanteɛ Absalom bra.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Yoab hwee ɔhene no nan ase, hyiraa no sɛ, “Ne korakora mu no, woapene me so, na woayɛ mʼabisadeɛ ama me.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na Yoab kɔɔ Gesur kɔfaa Absalom baa Yerusalem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Nanso, ɔhene maa ahyɛdeɛ yi sɛ, “Absalom tumi kɔ ɔno ankasa ne fie, nanso ɔnhwɛ na wamma mʼanim ha.” Enti, Absalom anhunu ɔhene no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Israel nyinaa, na obiara nni hɔ a ne ho yɛ fɛ, te sɛ Absalom. Ɛfiri ne tiri so kɔsi ne nan ase, na wohunu sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima ankasa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Afe biara, na ɔyi ne ti pɛnkorɔ, ɛfiri sɛ, ne nwi no yɛ adesoa ma no. Na sɛ ɔyi na ɔkari a, na ɛyɛ kilogram mmienu ne fa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na ɔwɔ mmammarima baasa ne ɔbabaa baako. Na ne babaa no din de Tamar. Na Tamar nso kura ahoɔfɛ a ɛmma ɔka.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Absalom tenaa Yerusalem mfeɛ mmienu a wanhunu ɔhene no da.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Afei, Absalom soma kɔfrɛɛ Yoab sɛ ɔnkɔka bi mma no, nanso Yoab ankɔ. Absalom somaa ne mprenu so, nanso Yoab ankɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Ɛno enti, Absalom ka kyerɛɛ nʼasomfoɔ sɛ, “Monkɔ na momfa ogya nkɔto Yoab atokoɔ afuo a ɛbɛn me deɛ no ho mu.” Na wɔde ogya kɔtoo afuo no mu, sɛdeɛ Absalom hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na Yoab baa Absalom nkyɛn bɛbisaa no sɛ, “Adɛn enti na wʼasomfoɔ akɔto mʼafuo mu ogya?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Na Absalom buaa no sɛ, “Ɛfiri sɛ, na mepɛ sɛ wokɔbisa ɔhene ma me sɛ, adɛn enti na ɔmaa me sane firi Gesur baeɛ, nanso ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔhunu mʼanim koraa? Ɛnneɛ, sɛ anka metenaa me dada mu hɔ ara a, anka ɛyɛ. Ma menhunu ɔhene no, na sɛ medi fɔ wɔ biribi ho a, ɔtumi kum me.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Enti, Yoab kaa asɛm a Absalom aka akyerɛ no no kyerɛɛ ɔhene no. Afei, Dawid frɛɛ ne ba a wate ne ho no, ma ɔbaa nʼanim. Absalom bɛduruu ɔhene no anim no, ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase, na Dawid fee nʼano.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13:1-14:33

content: Yei akyi no, Absalom tɔɔ teaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔ, na ɔbɔɔ mmarima aduonum paa sɛ wɔbɛdi nʼanim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Adekyeɛ biara, ɔsɔre ntɛm na wakɔtena kuropɔn no ɛpono ano. Na sɛ nnipa bi de asɛm bɛto ɔhene no anim sɛ ɔmmu ho atɛn a, Absalom bɛbisa faako a wɔfirie, na wɔakyerɛ abusuakuo a wɔfiri mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Na Absalom bɛka sɛ, “Wʼasɛm yɛ dɛ deɛ, nanso ɔhene nni obiara a ɔbɛtie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Sɛ meyɛ ɔtemmufoɔ anka mepɛ. Anka nnipa de wɔn nsɛm bɛba mʼanim, na mabu wɔn atɛn.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Sɛ nnipa pɛ sɛ wɔkoto no a, Absalom mma wɔn nyɛ saa na mmom ɔsɔ wɔn nsa, yɛ wɔn atuu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Absalom yɛɛ saa de nyaa Israelfoɔ no nyinaa wɔ nʼafa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Mfirinhyia ɛnan akyi, Absalom ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ, “Ma menkɔ Hebron na menkɔbɔ afɔdeɛ mma Awurade sɛdeɛ mahyɛ no bɔ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɛberɛ a na mewɔ Gesur no na mehyɛɛ saa bɔ no sɛ, ‘Sɛ Awurade de me sane ba Yerusalem a, mɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama no wɔ Hebron.’ ”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɔhene no kaa sɛ, “Ɛyɛ, kɔ na kɔdi wo bɔhyɛ so.” Enti, Absalom kɔɔ Hebron.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɛberɛ a ɔwɔ hɔ no, ɔfaa sum ase somaa abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Israel afanan nyinaa kɔhwanyanee ɔmanfoɔ de tiaa ɔhene no. Ne nkra ne sɛ, “Sɛ mote totorobɛnto nne pɛ a, monka sɛ, ‘Absalom adi ɔhene wɔ Hebron.’ ”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Absalom faa mmarima ahanu firii Yerusalem kaa ne ho a na wɔnnim Absalom nsusuiɛ yi ho hwee.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɛberɛ a Absalom rebɔ afɔdeɛ no, ɔsoma ma wɔkɔfaa Giloni Ahitofel a na ɔyɛ Dawid fotufoɔ firi ne kurom Gilo baeɛ. Ankyɛre nnipa bebree no ara bɛkaa Absalom ho, na atirisopam no mu yɛɛ den.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ankyɛre, ɔbɔfoɔ bi baa Yerusalem bɛka kyerɛɛ ɔhene Dawid sɛ, “Israel nyinaa atu di Absalom akyi sɛ wɔayɛ dɔm atia wo.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɛhɔ ara, Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ne mmarima sɛ, “Monyɛ no ntɛm na yɛnnwane mfiri ha, ansa na waduru ha, sɛdeɛ amanehunu bɛpare yɛn ne Yerusalem kuro mu no nyinaa.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Nʼafotufoɔ no buaa sɛ, “Yɛgyina wʼakyi. Biribiara a wogye di sɛ ɛyɛ no, yɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Enti, ɔhene no ne ne fiefoɔ sii so kɔɔ prɛko pɛ a wannya biribiara wɔ akyire sɛ ne mpenafoɔ edu bi a wɔbɛhwɛ nʼahemfie no so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɔhene no ne ne nkurɔfoɔ no faa fam, na wɔfaa kuropɔn no fa bi,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: maa Dawid akodɔm no bɛtwaa wɔn ho dii wɔn anim. Nnipa a wɔkaa Dawid ho kɔeɛ no yɛ Gitifoɔ ahansia a wɔfiri Gat a ne banbɔfoɔ nso ka ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Na ɔhene no bisaa Gatni Itai a ɔyɛ ɔsafohene no sɛ, “Adɛn enti na woka yɛn ho rekɔ? Sane kɔka wo nkurɔfoɔ ho, na monkɔ ɔhene Absalom nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ, woyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ wɔ Israel ne ɔmamfrani a wɔatwa wo asuo.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Woduruu ha nnora nko ara. Na ɛsɛ sɛ mehyɛ wo na wo ne yɛn kyini anaa? Me mpo, mennim baabi a yɛbɛkorɔ. Sane wʼakyi na kɔfa wʼakodɔm ka wo ho, na Awurade nkyerɛ wo ne dɔ ne ne nokorɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Nanso, Itai ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ, “Mede Awurade din ne wo ara wo nkwa ka ntam sɛ, baabiara a wobɛkɔ no, mɛkɔ bi a deɛ ɛbɛsi biara mfa me ho, sɛ ɛyɛ nkwa anaa owuo.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Dawid buaa no sɛ, “Ɛyɛ, ka yɛn ho.” Ɛno enti, Itai ne ne mmarima ahansia ne wɔn fiefoɔ kaa wɔn ho kɔeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Awerɛhoɔ kɛseɛ sii asase no so, ɛberɛ a ɔhene ne nʼakyidifoɔ resene korɔ no. Wɔtwaa Kidron bɔnhwa no de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ ɛserɛ so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Abiatar ne Sadok ne Lewifoɔ no faa Apam Adaka no, na wɔde sii kwankyɛn. Na wɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ kɔsii sɛ obiara seneeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Na ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ Sadok sɛ, “Sane fa Onyankopɔn Adaka no kɔ kuropɔn no mu. Sɛ menya Awurade anim adom a, ɔbɛsane de me aba ama mahunu Adaka no ne ne ntomadan no bio.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Nanso, sɛ ɔne me awie a, ma ɔnyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ ma no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Na ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok sɛ, “Me nhyehyɛeɛ nie: Wo ne Abiatar nyɛ kodɛɛ nsane nkɔ kuropɔn no mu a wo babarima Ahimaas ne Yonatan a ɔyɛ Abiatar babarima ka ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Mɛtwɛn wɔ faako a wɔtwa Asubɔnten Yordan kɔ ɛserɛ no so hɔ kɔsi sɛ mɛte mo nkra. Momma mente asɛm a ɛbɛsi Yerusalem, ansa na makɔ ɛserɛ so.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Enti, Sadok ne Abiatar faa Onyankopɔn Adaka no de sane kɔɔ Yerusalem, na wɔtenaa hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Dawid faa ɛkwan a ɛkɔ Ngo Bepɔ so no so a, ɔrekɔ no nyinaa, na ɔretwa adwo. Na wakata ne tiri so, ɛnna ne nan sisi fam saa ara a ɛkyerɛ awerɛhoɔdie. Na nnipa a wɔka ne ho no nso katakataa wɔn tiri so, twaa adwo ɛberɛ a wɔgu so reforo bepɔ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɛberɛ a obi ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ, afei deɛ ne ɔfotufoɔ Ahitofel taa Absalom akyi no, Dawid bɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ, “Ao Awurade, ma Ahitofel ntu Absalom ɛfo bɔne!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Wɔduruu Ngo Bepɔ no atifi baabi a nnipa som Onyankopɔn no, Dawid hunuu Husai a ɔfiri Arki a ɔretwɛn no. Na Husai asunsuane nʼatadeɛ mu, de dɔteɛ afɔre ne tirim, de kyerɛ awerɛhoɔdie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Sɛ wo ne me kɔ a, wobɛyɛ adesoa ama me.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Sane kɔ Yerusalem, na ka kyerɛ Absalom sɛ, ‘Afei, mɛyɛ wo fotufoɔ sɛdeɛ da bi hɔ no na meyɛ wʼagya fotufoɔ no.’ Ɛba saa a, wobɛtumi atia Ahitofel afotuo mu, asɛe no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Asɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar wɔ hɔ. Ka adwene a wɔafa wɔ me ho, pɛ sɛ wɔkyere me no kyerɛ wɔn,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: na wɔbɛsoma wɔn mmammarima Ahimaas ne Yonatan na wɔabɛhwehwɛ me, aka deɛ ɛrekɔ so akyerɛ me.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Enti, Dawid adamfo Husai sane kɔɔ Yerusalem, kɔduruu hɔ berɛ korɔ no a Absalom nso duruu hɔ no mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Dawid sianee bepɔ no pɛ na ɔne Mefiboset ɔsomfoɔ Siba hyiaeɛ. Na ɔdi mfunumu mmienu a wɔahyehyɛ burodo mua ahanu, bobe aba a wɔabɔ no ntowantowa ɔha ne nsã nwoma kotokuo ma wɔ wɔn so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɔhene no bisaa Siba sɛ, “Na yeinom nso ɛ?” Na Siba buaa sɛ, “Mfunumu no, mo nkurɔfoɔ ntena wɔn so, na burodo no ne aduaba no, wɔmfa mma mmeranteɛ no na wɔnni. Na nsã no nso, momfa nkɔ ɛserɛ so hɔ, na wɔn a ɔbrɛ enti wɔbɛtɔ baha no, anom.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Na ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ, “Na Mefiboset wɔ he?” Siba buaa sɛ, “Ɔkaa Yerusalem. Ɔkaa sɛ, ‘Ɛnnɛ, mɛsane agye me nana Saulo ahemman no.’ ”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content:
Ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ Siba sɛ, “Sɛ saa na ɛte deɛ a, mede biribiara a ɛyɛ Mefiboset dea no mema wo.”
    Siba buaa sɛ, “Meda wo ase awura. Ɛberɛ biara, biribiara a wobɛka akyerɛ me sɛ menyɛ no, mɛyɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɛberɛ a ɔhene Dawid ne ne nkurɔfoɔ retwam wɔ Bahurim no, ɔbarima bi pue firii akuraa no ase bɛdomee wɔn. Na saa ɔbarima no din de Simei, Gera a ɔyɛ Saulo busuani babarima.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɔpaa Dawid ne ne mpanimfoɔ ne akodɔm a wɔatwa wɔn ho ahyia no nyinaa aboɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɔteaam guu Dawid so sɛ, “Firi hanom kɔ! Mogyapɛfoɔ a ɔte sɛ woɔ! Ɔsansani!

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Awurade atua wo ka sɛ wohwiee Saulo ne ne fiefoɔ mogya guiɛ. Wowiaa nʼahennwa, na afei Awurade de ahemman no ahyɛ wo babarima Absalom nsa. Wobɛnom wʼankasa aduro, wo mogyapɛfoɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɛnna Seruia babarima Abisai bisaa ɔhene no sɛ, “Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔkraman funu yi tumi dome me wura, ɔhene? Ma menkɔ na menkɔtwa ne ti.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Nanso, ɔhene no kaa sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn na me ne mo Seruia mmammarima bɛyɛ? Sɛ Awurade aka akyerɛ no sɛ, ɔnnome me a, me ne hwan a mɛtumi aka akyerɛ no sɛ ɔnnyae?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abisai ne ne mpanimfoɔ sɛ, “Me babarima a ɔyɛ mʼankasa mogya pɛ sɛ ɔkum me. Na ɛdeɛn na ɛsi Saulo busuani ho kwan sɛ ɔnyɛ saa ara. Monnyaa no, momma ɔnnome, ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade na waka akyerɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ saa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ebia, Awurade bɛhunu sɛ wɔreyɛ me bɔne, na ɔde papa atua me nnome a me nsa aka no ɛnnɛ yi no so ka.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Enti, Dawid ne ne mmarima toaa so kɔɔ wɔn ɛkwan a saa ɛberɛ no, na Simei nso nam bepɔ bi a ɛbɛn wɔn so. Ɔrekɔ no nyinaa, na ɔredome, toto aboɔ bɔ Dawid, tu mfuturo gu ewiem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɔhene ne ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa brɛeɛ wɔ ɛkwan so enti, wɔduruu Asubɔnten Yordan ho no, wɔgyee wɔn ahome.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Absalom ne Israel mmarima nyinaa baa Yerusalem a Ahitofel ka wɔn ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Na Husai a ɔfiri Arki a ɔyɛ Dawid adamfo no, kɔɔ Absalom nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Ɔhene nkwa so! Ɔhene nkwa so!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Na Absalom bisaa Husai sɛ, “Yei ne ɛkwan a wode wʼadamfo Dawid fa soɔ? Adɛn enti na wo ne wʼadamfo ankɔ?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Husai ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ, “Mewɔ ha ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ adwuma ma ɔbarima a Awurade ne Israel ayi no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Deɛ ɛka ho bio ne sɛ, hwan na ɛsɛ sɛ mesom no? Sɛdeɛ mesom wʼagya no, saa ara na mɛsom wo.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ɛnna Absalom danee ne ho bisaa Ahitofel sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn bio na menyɛ?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ahitofel buaa no sɛ, “Kɔ na wo ne wʼagya mpenafoɔ no nna, ɛfiri sɛ, wagya wɔn hɔ sɛ wɔnhwɛ ahemfie hɔ. Ɛno bɛma Israel nyinaa ahunu sɛ, woabu no animtia a ɛboro nkabom so, na wɔde wɔn ho bɛma wo.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Enti, wɔsii ntomadan wɔ ahemfie no atifi baabi a obiara bɛhunu, na Absalom kɔɔ ntomadan no mu, na ɔne nʼagya mpenafoɔ no daeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Absalom tiee Ahitofel afotuo sɛdeɛ Dawid yɛeɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Na asɛm biara a ɛfiri Ahitofel anom baeɛ no mu nyansa no, yɛɛ sɛdeɛ ɛfiri Onyankopɔn anom.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 15:1-16:23

content: Ahitofel ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ, “Mɛyi akodɔm mpem dumienu, na mafiri ha anadwo yi akɔtaa Dawid so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Mɛto no wɔ ɛberɛ a wabrɛ na nʼaba mu abu. Ɔne nʼakodɔm nyinaa bɛbɔ hu na wɔadwane. Ɔhene no nko ara na mɛbɔ no ahwe,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: na mede nnipa no asane abrɛ wo, sɛdeɛ ayeforɔ kɔ ne kunu nkyɛn. Saa onipa yi nkwa nko ara na worehwehwɛ. Afei nnipa no nyinaa bɛka a wɔrenha obiara.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Saa nhyehyɛeɛ yi sɔɔ Absalom ne Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ani.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Nanso, Absalom kaa sɛ, “Momfrɛ Husai a ɔfiri Arki no mmra na yɛntie deɛ ɔwɔ ka.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Husai baeɛ no, Absalom kaa deɛ Ahitofel aka no kyerɛɛ no. Afei ɔbisaa no sɛ, “Wʼadwene ne sɛn? Yɛmfa Ahitofel afotuo no anaa? Na sɛ ɛnte saa a, kyerɛ yɛn wʼadwene.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Husai buaa Absalom sɛ, “Mʼadwene ne sɛ saa ɛberɛ yi deɛ Ahitofel ayɛ mfomsoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Wonim wʼagya ne ne dɔm; wɔyɛ akofoɔ akɛseɛ. Saa ɛberɛ yi, wɔn ani abre sɛ sisire a wɔawia ne mma wɔ wiram. Ɛno da nkyɛn a, wʼagya nim de wɔ akodie mu. Ɔne nʼakodɔm no rentena anadwo yi.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Sɛ merekasa yi, wakɔtɛ ɔbodan bi mu anaa baabi foforɔ. Na sɛ ɔdi ɛkan to hyɛ mo so na mo mu kakra bi mpo totɔ a, ehu bɛtɔ wo dɔm no so na obiara bɛteam sɛ wɔrekunkum wo dɔm no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na sɛ ɛba saa a, ɔsraani a ɔyɛ nnam a nʼakoma te sɛ gyata no koraa, ehu bɛma wabɔ hu. Na Israel nyinaa nim sɛ wʼagya yɛ ɔkofoɔ, na wɔn a wɔka ne ho no nso bo yɛ duru.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: “Enti, metu wo fo sɛ, boa Israel nyinaa ano, ɛfiri Dan kɔsi Beer-Seba. Woyɛ saa a wobɛnya akodɔm a wɔn dodoɔ bɛyɛ sɛ mpoano anwea. Na megye medi sɛ wʼankasa bɛdi akodɔm no anim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na sɛ yɛhunu Dawid a, yɛbɛto ahyɛ no so, sɛdeɛ bosuo gu asase so, a ɔno ne mmarima no mu baako mpo nka.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na sɛ Dawid adwane kɔ kuropɔn bi so a, wode Israel akodɔm nyinaa bɛkɔ hɔ. Afei, yɛbɛtumi afa ntampehoma de atwe kuro no afasuo, akɔgu bɔnhwa a ɛbɛn mu, kɔsi sɛ ɛboɔ biara a ɛwɔ mu no bɛyam.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Afei, Absalom ne Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa kaa sɛ, “Husai afotuo no yɛ sene Ahitofel deɛ no.” Ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade ahyehyɛ sɛ Ahitofel afotuo pa a ɔde ama no bɛsɛe, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, ɔhaw ne abɛbrɛsɛ bɛba Absalom so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na Husai kɔkaa asɛm a Ahitofel aka ne ɔno ankasa adwenkyerɛ no kyerɛɛ asɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, “Ntɛm! Monkɔhwehwɛ Dawid, na monka nkyerɛ no sɛ, ɔnntena Asubɔnten Yordan aworɔso hɔ anadwo yi. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtwa kɔ ɛserɛ no so akyi, anyɛ saa a, ɔne nʼakodɔm nyinaa bɛwuwu.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Yonatan ne Ahimaas tenaa En-Rogel, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, wɔrenkɔ kuro no mu na wɔnnsane mpue. Na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bi sɛ abaawa bi de nkra a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde kɔma ɔhene Dawid no bɛbrɛ wɔn.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Nanso abarimaa bi hunuu wɔn sɛ wɔrefiri En-Rogel akɔ Dawid nkyɛn enti, ɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Absalom. Na wɔdwane kɔɔ Bahurim, maa ɔbarima bi de wɔn kɔsiee abura bi a ɛwɔ nʼadihɔ mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɔbarima no yere de ntoma hataa abura no so, de atokoɔ guu so te sɛ deɛ ɔrehata no awia so, na obiara ansusu sɛ nnipa hyɛ abura no mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content:
Ɛberɛ a Absalom mmarima no duruu hɔ no, wɔbisaa ɔbaa no sɛ, “Woahunu Ahimaas ne Yonatan anaa?”
    Ɔbuaa wɔn sɛ, “Na wɔwɔ ha deɛ, nanso wɔatwa asuwa no kɔ.” Absalom mmarima no hwehwɛɛ wɔn, nanso wɔanhunu wɔn enti, wɔsane kɔɔ Yerusalem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Afei mmarima baanu no firii abura no mu, de mmirika kɔɔ ɔhene Dawid nkyɛn kɔbɔɔ no amaneɛ sɛ, “Firi ha tware asuo no ntɛm so anadwo yi!” Wɔkaa Ahitofel afotuo a ɛbɛma wɔakyere no akum no no kyerɛɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Enti, Dawid ne nnipa no nyinaa tutuu so, kɔtwaa Yordan. Ɛduruu ahemadakye no, na obiara atwa Yordan kɔ nʼagya.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ahitofel hunuu sɛ nʼanim agu ase, ɛfiri sɛ wɔamfa nʼafotuo no, ɔhyehyɛɛ nʼafunumu tenaa ne so, kɔɔ ne kurom. Ɔtotoo ne nneɛma yie, na ɔhyɛɛ ne ho akɔmfo. Enti, ɔwuiɛ ma wɔsiee no wɔ nʼagya da mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ankyɛre na Dawid duruu Mahanaim. Saa ɛberɛ yi na Absalom aboaboa Israel akodɔm no nyinaa ano a ɔdi wɔn anim rekɔtwa Asubɔnten Yordan.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Absalom yii Amasa de no tuaa akodɔm no ano, sii Yoab a na anka ɔyɛ Dawid sahene no ananmu. Amasa yɛ ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Yitra, a ɔyɛ Israelni a ɔwaree Abigail a ɔyɛ Nahas babaa, na ɔyɛ Seruia nuabaa, a ɔyɛ Yoab na no ba.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Israelfoɔ no ne Absalom tenaa Gilead asase so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na Dawid duruu Mahanaim no, Nahas a ɔfiri Raba babarima Sobi Amonni no, kyeaa no fɛ so. Saa ara na Amiel a ɔfiri Lo-debar babarima Makir ne Gileadni Barsilai a ɔfiri Rogelim nso gyee no fɛ so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Wɔbrɛɛ no kɛtɛ, nkuku ne nkaka, atokoɔ, asikyiresiam, nkyeweɛ, asɛ ne asɛdua,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: ɛwoɔ ne nufosuo ani sradeɛ ne anantwie nufosuo a akyenkyene mua. Wɔde brɛɛ Dawid ne ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho no. Na wɔkaa sɛ, “Mo nyinaa moabrɛbrɛ, na ɛkɔm ne sukɔm de mo ɛfiri sɛ moanante ɛkwan tenten wɔ ɛserɛ so.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Afei, Dawid yiyii asahene ne asafohene dii nʼakodɔm anim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Yoab na ɔtuaa wɔn mu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako ano. Yoab nuabarima Abisai a na ɔyɛ Seruia babarima na ɔtuaa nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso ano. Ɛnna nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako a aka no, Gatni Itai na ɔtuaa ano. Ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ nʼakodɔm no sɛ, “Me ne mo na ɛrekɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Nanso, ne mmarima no tiaa mu dendeenden sɛ, “Ɛnsɛ sɛ wokɔ bi. Na sɛ ɛba sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛwae, na yɛdwane, na sɛ mpo, yɛn mu fa koraa wuwu a, ɛrennuru Absalom akodɔm no ho hwee. Wo ara na wɔbɛhwehwɛ. Wo nko ara yɛ yɛn mu ɔpedu enti, ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛtena kurom na sɛ mmoa bi ho hia yɛn a, wode bɛba.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content:
Ɔhene penee so sɛ, “Sɛ modwene sɛ ɛno ne adwene pa deɛ a, mate.”
    Enti, ɔkɔgyinaa kuro no ɛpono ano, ɛberɛ a akodɔm no rekɔ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na ɔhene no hyɛɛ Yoab, Abisai ne Itai sɛ, “Me enti mo ne abɔfra Absalom nni no bɔkɔɔ so.” Na akodɔm no nyinaa tee saa nhyɛ a ɔhene hyɛɛ nʼasafohene no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Enti, ɔko no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ Efraim kwaeɛ mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na Dawid mmarima no yɛɛ Israel akodɔm no pasaa. Ɛyɛ akofena ano kum, na da no, mmarima ɔpeduonu na wɔhweree wɔn nkwa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɔko no didi kɔɔ nkuro so, na ɛsiane kwaeɛ no enti, nnipa pii wuwuiɛ sene wɔn a wɔwuu wɔ akofena ano no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɔko no gyina mu no, Absalom puee prɛko pɛ wɔ Dawid mmarima no bi mu. Ɔpɛɛ sɛ ɔdwane wɔ nʼafunumpɔnkɔ so, nanso ɔdwane kɔfaa dɔtɔ bi mu wɔ odum bi ase. Ɔdɔtɔ no kyekyeree ne tirinwi, ma ɔkaa mu. Nʼafunumpɔnkɔ no deɛ, na kɔ ara na ɔrekɔ enti, ɔgyaa no hɔ a, ɔsensɛn dɔtɔ no mu a ɔreto adonko wɔ ewiem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Dawid mmarima no baako hunuu asɛm a asi no, ɔka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ, “Mehunuu Absalom sɛ ɔsensɛn dua bi so wɔ dɔtɔ mu.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Yoab bisaa sɛ, “Asɛm pa ara? Wohunuu no na woanku no? Anka mɛma wo dwetɛ gram ɔha ne dunan (114) ne akokoɔduru abɔwomu sɛ akradeɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɔbarima no buaa sɛ, “Sɛ anka wobɛma me dwetɛ kilogram dubaako ne fa koraa a, anka merenyɛ saa. Yɛn nyinaa tee sɛ, ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ wo, Abisai ne Itai sɛ, ‘Me enti, obiara nnyɛ aberanteɛ Absalom bɔne.’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na sɛ mebu ɔhene asɛm so kum ne babarima a, anka deɛ ɛbɛyɛ biara, ɔhene bɛhwehwɛ deɛ ɔyɛɛ saa. Na anka wʼankasa ne onipa a anka wobɛyi me ama.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Yoab kaa sɛ, “Saa nkwaseasɛm yi ayɛ yie.” Enti, ɔtwee mpɛmɛ mmiɛnsa de wowɔɔ Absalom akoma mu ɛberɛ a na ɔsensɛn odum no so a na ɔnwuiɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Yoab akodeɛkurafoɔ no mu mmeranteɛ edu twaa Absalom ho hyiaeɛ, na wɔkumm no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na Yoab hyɛnee totorobɛnto, maa akodɔm no gyaee Israel so taa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Wɔfaa Absalom amu no to twenee amena donkudonku bi mu wɔ kwaeɛ mu hɔ, na wɔsoaa abotan guu ne so. Na Israelfoɔ no nyinaa dwane kɔɔ wɔn afie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɛberɛ a Absalom te ase no, ɔsii nkaeɛdum bi wɔ ɔhene bɔnhwa mu de kaee ɔno ara ne ho, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔdwenee sɛ, “Menni ɔbabarima biara a ɔbɛyɛ nkaedeɛ biara de akae me din.” Ɔde nkaeɛdum no too ne ho, na wɔfrɛ no Absalom Nkaeɛdum de bɛsi ɛnnɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na Sadok babarima Ahimaas kaa sɛ, “Momma mentu mmirika nkɔbɔ ɔhene amaneɛ sɛ, Awurade ayi no afiri atamfoɔ nsam.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na Yoab nso ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Sɛ ɔhene ba awu a, ɛnyɛ asɛm papa mma no. Wobɛtumi akɔbɔ saa amaneɛ no ɛda foforɔ bi, na ɛnyɛ ɛnnɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na Yoab ka kyerɛɛ Kusni bi sɛ, “Kɔ na kɔka deɛ woahunu no kyerɛ ɔhene.” Ɛhɔ ara na Kusni no bɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ Yoab anim, na ɔtuu mmirika kɔeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content:
Bio, Sadok babarima Ahimaas ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ, “Deɛ ɛbɛba biara mmra, ma me ne Kusni no nkɔ.”
    Nanso, Yoab bisaa no sɛ, “Me ba, adɛn enti na wopɛ sɛ wokɔ? Wonni amanneɛbɔ biara a ɛbɛma wo abasobɔdeɛ biara.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content:
Ɔkaa sɛ, “Mepene so, nanso ma menkɔ.”
    Enti Yoab ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Kɔ!” Na Ahimaas faa tata no so kɔeɛ, kɔsianee Kusni no ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɛberɛ a Dawid te kuro no ɛpono ano no, ne wɛmfoɔ no kɔɔ kuro no ɛpono no atifi wɔ ɔfasuo no so. Ɔtoo nʼani no, ɔhunuu sɛ obi de mmirika reba.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɔwɛmfoɔ no teaam ka kyerɛɛ Dawid na ɔhene no buaa sɛ, “Sɛ ɔno nko ara na ɔnam deɛ a, ebia, na ɔde asɛm pa nam.” Na ɔreba ara, na ɔpinkyɛe.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content:
Afei ɔwɛmfoɔ no hunuu sɛ ɔbarima foforɔ nso di so reba, na ɔteaam sɛ, “Hwɛ onipa foforɔ bi de mmirika reba!”
    Ɔhene no kaa sɛ, “Ebia, na ɔno nso de asɛm pa na ɛnam.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content:
Ɔwɛmfoɔ no kaa sɛ, “Ɔbarima a ɔdi ɛkan no sɛ Sadok babarima Ahimaas.”
    Ɔhene no kaa sɛ, “Ɔyɛ onipa pa a, ɔde asɛm pa nam.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na Ahimaas teaam, frɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ, “Biribiara yɛ!” Ɔkotoo wɔ ɔhene no anim, de nʼanim butuu fam kaa sɛ, “Animuonyam nka Awurade, wo Onyankopɔn. Ɔde nnipa a wɔyɛɛ dɔm tiaa me wura ɔhene ahyɛ ne nsa.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɔhene bisaa sɛ, “Na aberanteɛ, Absalom ho yɛ anaa?” Ahimaas buaa sɛ, “Ɛberɛ a Yoab yɛɛ nʼadwene sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsoma ɔhene ɔsomfoɔ ne me wo ɔsomfoɔ no, mehunuu sɛ nneɛma ayɛ basaa a na menhunu mu yie.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Gyina nkyɛn ha na twɛn.” Enti, ɔgyinaa nkyɛn twɛnee.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na Kusni no bɛduruiɛ kaa sɛ, “Me wura, Nana, tie asɛm pa a mede nam! Ɛnnɛ, Awurade ayi wo afiri wɔn a wɔsɔre tiaa wo no nyinaa nsam.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Na ɔhene bisaa Kusni no sɛ, “Na aberanteɛ Absalom ho te sɛn?” Kusni no buaa sɛ, “Me wura ɔhene, atamfoɔ nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔsɔre tia wo, pɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wo bɔne no, nhunu amane sɛ saa aberanteɛ no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ɔhene ho wosoeɛ. Ɔfaa ɛkwan ano ɛpono no mu kɔɔ ne dan mu kɔsuiɛ, twaa adwo. Ɔrekɔ no, ɔkaa sɛ, “Ao, me ba Absalom! Me ba, me ba Absalom! Anka menwu nnya wo! Ao, Absalom, me ba, me ba!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 17:1-18:33

content: Ankyɛre na nkra duruu Yoab nkyɛn sɛ ɔhene no resu, redi awerɛhoɔ wɔ Absalom ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɛberɛ a akodɔm no tee ɔhene no awerɛhoɔ a ɔredi wɔ ne ba no ho no, nkonimdie mu anigyeɛ a na wɔwɔ mu saa da no danee awerɛhoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Wɔwiaa wɔn ho kɔɔ kuro no mu sɛdeɛ wɔn a wɔadi nkoguo de aniwuo dwane firi ɔko mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔhene de ne nsa kataa nʼanim, kɔɔ so twaa adwo sɛ, “Ao, me ba Absalom! Ao, Absalom, me ba, me ba!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na Yoab kɔɔ ɔhene no dan mu kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Ɛnnɛ yɛagye wo, ne wo mmammarima, ne wo mmammaa, ne wo yerenom, ne wo mpenafoɔ nkwa. Nanso, woreyɛ yei de gu yɛn anim ase te sɛ deɛ yɛayɛ bɔne bi.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Wodɔ wʼatamfoɔ, na wotan wʼadɔfoɔ. Woada no adi ɛnnɛ sɛ, yɛnsɛ hwee mma wo. Sɛ Absalom te ase, na yɛn nyinaa awuwu a, anka wopɛ no saa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Afei, firi kɔ seesei, na kɔma akodɔm no amo, na mebɔ Awurade din, ka ntam sɛ, sɛ woanyɛ saa a, wɔn mu baako koraa nka ha anadwo yi. Na ɛbɛma woagyigya asene kane no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na ɔhene no firii adi kɔtenaa kuro no abɔntenpono no ano. Na asɛm no trɛɛ kuro no mu nyinaa sɛ ɔwɔ hɔ no, obiara kɔɔ ne nkyɛn. Saa ɛberɛ no na Israelfoɔ a wɔtaa Absalom akyi no nyinaa adwane kɔ wɔn afie mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na Israel mmusuakuo no nyinaa mu, na wɔredi abooboo, gye akyinnyeɛ. Na nnipa no reka sɛ, “Ɔhene no gyee yɛn firii atamfoɔ a wɔyɛ Filistifoɔ nsam, nanso Absalom taa no so, pamoo no firii ɔman no mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na seesei Absalom a yɛsraa no sɛ ɔmmɛdi yɛn so ɔhene no nso awu. Momma yɛnkɔka nkyerɛ Dawid na ɔnsane mmra mmɛdi yɛn so.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na ɔhene Dawid somaa asɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar, ma wɔkɔbisaa Yuda mpanimfoɔ sɛ, “Adɛn enti na mo deɛ, mompɛ sɛ mode ɔhene ahennie bɛsane ama no? Na mate sɛ Israel nyinaa ayɛ krado, na mo nko ara na motwentwɛn mo nan ase.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Moyɛ mʼabusuafoɔ, mʼabusuakuo, mʼankasa me honam ne me mogya. Na ɛno enti, adɛn enti na motwa toɔ wɔ wɔn a wɔpene sɛ mɛsane aba no mu?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Dawid ma wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Amasa sɛ, “Sɛ woyɛ me wɔfaase yi, sɛ manyɛ wo ɔsahene ansi Yoab ananmu a, Onyankopɔn ne me nni no nwononwono.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Afei, Amasa korɔkorɔɔ Yuda ntuanofoɔ nyinaa, ma wɔtiee no sɛ nnipa korɔ. Wɔde saa asɛm yi kɔtoo ɔhene anim sɛ, “Wo ne wɔn a wɔne wo wɔ hɔ no nyinaa mmra yɛn nkyɛn.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na ɔhene no de nʼani kyerɛɛ Yerusalem. Ɔduruu Asubɔnten Yordan ho no, Yudafoɔ bɛhyiaa no sɛ wɔde no retwa asuo no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Gera a ɔyɛ Benyaminni a ɔfiri Bahurim babarima Simei ne Yuda mmarima yɛɛ ntɛm kɔhyiaa ɔhene Dawid.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔrekɔ no, na Benyaminfoɔ apem ka ne ho a, na Siba a na ɔyɛ Saulo fidua mu soodoni, ne ne mmammarima dunum ne nʼasomfoɔ aduonu ka ho. Wɔyɛɛ ntɛm dii ɔhene no ɛkan kɔduruu Yordan hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content:
Wɔtwa kɔɔ konkɔnoa kɔfaa ɔhene fiefoɔ de wɔn twaa asuo no, na wɔboaa wɔn wɔ ɛkwan biara a wɔbɛtumi so.
    Ɛberɛ a ɔhene no rebɛtwa asuo no, Gera babarima Simei kɔhwee nʼanim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔsrɛɛ no sɛ, “Me wura ɔhene, fa me bɔne kyɛ me. Nkae amumuyɛsɛm a meyɛeɛ ɛberɛ a wofirii Yerusalem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Mahunu bɔne a mayɛ, enti na madi ɛkan wɔ Yosef abusua nyinaa mu rebɛkyea wo yi.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na Seruia babarima Abisai kaa sɛ, “Simei sɛ owuo, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔdomee deɛ Awurade asra no no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na Dawid bisaa sɛ, “Mo Seruia mma, ɛdeɛn na me ne mo wɔ yɛ? Ɛnnɛ nnyɛ da a wɔkum obi. Ɛyɛ anigyeɛ da! Masane abɛdi ɔhene wɔ Israel so bio!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Enti, ɔhene no kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Simei sɛ, “Wɔrenkum wo.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Mefiboset a ɔyɛ Saulo nana nso kɔhyiaa ɔhene no bi. Ɛfiri ɛberɛ a ɔhene no kɔeɛ no, na ɔnnwaree ne nan ase, mmubuu ne hweneanonwi so, nsii ne ntadeɛ da, kɔsii sɛ ɔhene baa asomdwoeɛ mu no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ, “Mefiboset, adɛn enti na wo ne me ankɔ?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔbuaa sɛ, “Nana, me ɔsomfoɔ Siba daadaa me. Meyɛ obubuafo enti, mekaa sɛ, ‘hyehyɛ mʼafunumu ma me, na mentena ne so, sɛdeɛ mɛtumi ne ɔhene akɔ.’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Siba abɛsɛe me akyerɛ me wura ɔhene sɛ mampɛ sɛ meba. Nanso menim sɛ wote sɛ Onyankopɔn ɔbɔfoɔ; ne saa enti, yɛ deɛ wogye di sɛ ɛyɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Biribiara mfata me ne mʼabusuafoɔ sɛ owuo a ɛbɛfiri me wura, ɔhene, nanso, woahyɛ me animuonyam wɔ wɔn a wɔdidi wo ɛpono so no mu. Enti, tumi bɛn na mewɔ sɛ mebisa ɔhene deɛ mehwehwɛ?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Adɛn enti na wʼasɛm aware? Mehyɛ mo sɛ, wo ne Siba nkyɛ nsase no mu.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Mefiboset ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ, “Ɛdɔɔ me so sɛ me wura ɔhene asane aba efie dwoodwoo yi, ma Siba mfa biribiara.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Gileadni Barsilai nso firi Rogelim baa sɛ ɔrebɛboa ama ɔhene atwa Yordan.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na Barsilai abɔ akɔkoraa a wadi mfeɛ aduɔwɔtwe, na ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ kɛseɛ. Ɔno na ɔmaa ɔhene biribi diiɛ ɛberɛ a na ɔte Mahanaim no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ Barsilai sɛ, “Wo ne me ntwa, na wo ne me nkɔtena Yerusalem, na mɛhwɛ wo.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Nanso, Barsilai buaa ɔhene sɛ, “Aka me nna ahe a ɛsɛ sɛ me ne wo kɔtena Yerusalem, Nana?

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Madi mfirinhyia aduɔwɔtwe, na biribiara nyɛ me akɔnnɔ. Aduane ne nsã nyɛ me dɛ. Nnwontofoɔ nne so, merente na adesoa nko ara na mɛyɛ ama Nana.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Animuonyam a mepɛ ara ne sɛ me ne Nana bɛtwa asuo no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ma wo ɔsomfoɔ nsane nʼakyi, sɛdeɛ mɛwu wɔ me ara me kurom faako a wɔsiee mʼawofoɔ. Na me babarima Kimham nie. Ma ɔne me wura ɔhene nkɔ na ade pa biara a wopɛ no, yɛ ma no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔhene no gye too mu kaa sɛ, “Ɛyɛ, Kimham ne me bɛkɔ, na deɛ anka mɛyɛ ama woɔ no, mɛyɛ ama no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Enti, nnipa no nyinaa ne ɔhene no twaa Yordan. Ɔhene no yɛɛ Barsilai atuu, hyiraa no. Na Barsilai sane nʼakyi kɔɔ ne kurom.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔhene faa Kimham kaa ne ho kɔɔ Gilgal. Yuda akodɔm nyinaa ne Israel akodɔm no mu fa de ɔhene twaa asuo no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Nanso, Israel mmarima nyinaa bɛnwiinwii kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ, “Adɛn enti na yɛn nuanom Yuda mmarima awia wo kɔ, na wɔde Ɔhene ne ne fiefoɔ ne Dawid mmarima nyinaa a wɔka ne ho no akɔtwa Yordan aba?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Yuda mmarima nyinaa buaa Israel mmarima no sɛ, “Yɛyɛɛ saa, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔhene no yɛ yɛn busuani pɛɛ. Adɛn enti na mo bo afu saa asɛm yi ho? Yɛannye no hwee na ɔno nso amma yɛn aduane anaa akyɛdeɛ biara nso.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content:
Na Israel mmarima buaa Yuda mmarima no sɛ, “Yɛwɔ mmusuakuo edu wɔ Israel na ɛno enti yɛwɔ ɔhene no mu kyɛfa edu. Na adɛn enti na mobu yɛn abomfiaa? Ɛnyɛ yɛn na yɛdii ɛkan kaa sɛ, wɔmfa yɛn ɔhene nsane mmra?”
    Na Yuda mmarima no ano yɛɛ den sene Israel mmarima no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content:
Mmerɛ no ara mu, Dawid bisaa Awurade sɛ, “Mensane nkɔ Yuda anaa?”
    Awurade buaa no sɛ, “Kɔ.”
    Dawid bisaa no sɛ, “Kuro bɛn na menkɔ so?”
    Awurade buaa no sɛ, “Hebron.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Dawid yerenom ne Ahinoam a ɔfiri Yesreel ne Abigail a ɔfiri Karmel a na ɔyɛ Nabal yere no. Enti Dawid ne ne yerenom,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: ne ne mmarima ne wɔn fiefoɔ nyinaa tu kɔɔ Yuda, na wɔkɔtenaa Hebron ne ne nkuro so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Afei, Yuda ntuanofoɔ kɔɔ Hebron, kɔsraa Dawid ngo sii no ɔhene wɔ Yuda abusuakuo so.
    Na ɛberɛ a Dawid tee sɛ Yabes Gilead mmarima asie Saulo no,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: ɔtoo wɔn nkra sɛ, “Awurade nhyira mo sɛ moayi nokorɛ a ɛte saa adi, ama mo wura Saulo, na moasie no animuonyam so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na afei, Awurade ne mo nni no yie na ɔntua mo dɔ sononko yi so ka. Na me nso mɛtua mo deɛ moayɛ yi so ka.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Afei a Saulo awu yi, mepɛ sɛ mobɛyɛ mʼasomfoɔ nokwafoɔ sɛ Yudafoɔ a wɔasra me ngo sɛ menni wɔn so ɔhene no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Ner babarima Abner a na ɔyɛ Saulo safohene wɔ nʼakodɔm so ne Saulo babarima Is-Boset kɔɔ Mahanaim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛhɔ na ɔsii Is-Boset ɔhene wɔ Gilead, Yesreel, Efraim, Benyamin, Asurifoɔ asase ne Israel nyinaa so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛberɛ a Is-Boset dii adeɛ no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduanan, na ɔdii adeɛ firi Mahanaim mfeɛ mmienu. Na Yuda abusuakuo no dii Dawid nokorɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Dawid yɛɛ Hebron ne kuropɔn. Na ɔdii Yuda so ɔhene mfirinhyia nson ne fa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛda koro bi, Abner dii Is-Boset akodɔm anim, firi Mahanaim kɔɔ Gibeon.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Saa ɛberɛ korɔ no ara mu, Seruia babarima Yoab nso dii Dawid akodɔm anim, firi Hebron na wɔhyiaa Abner wɔ Gibeon ɔtadeɛ ho. Akuo mmienu no tenatenaa ase a na wɔdi nhwɛanimu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Afei, Abner susuu ho kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ, “Ma yɛmfa yɛn akofoɔ no mu kakra, na wɔmfa wɔn nsa nni ako nyɛ oyikyerɛ.”
    Yoab penee so kaa sɛ, “Wɔnsɔre nko ɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Enti, wɔyii mmarima dumienu firii ekuo biara mu sɛ wɔnni wɔn ho ako.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Obiara sɔɔ ne tiafoɔ tirinwi mu, de nʼakofena wowɔɔ wɔn ho, maa wɔn nyinaa wuwuiɛ. Enti, wɔfrɛ atɔeɛ mu hɔ sɛ Akofena Afuo de bɛsi ɛnnɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Afei, akodɔm mmienu no de ɔko hyehyɛɛ so, na saa da no baa awieeɛ no, na Dawid akodɔm no adi Abner ne Israel so nkonim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Yoab, Abisai ne Asahel a wɔyɛ Seruia mmammarima baasa no ka Dawid akodɔm no ho saa da no. Na Asahel tu mmirika te sɛ ɔforoteɛ,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: na ɔpamoo Abner ara sɛ, ɔbɛkyere no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Ɛberɛ a Abner twaa nʼani hunuu sɛ ɔgu ne so no, ɔteaam sɛ, “Wo nie, Asahel!”
    Ɔbuaa sɛ, “Aane, ɛyɛ me!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Abner ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Ɛnneɛ, kɔpɛ obi foforɔ, na wone no nko. Kɔ na kɔsi mmeranteɛ no baako so, na gye nʼakodeɛ a ɛwɔ ne ho nyinaa.” Nanso, Asahel, kɔɔ so taa no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Bio, Abner teaam ka kyerɛɛ Asahel sɛ, “Firi ha kɔ! Sɛ mekum wo a, merentumi nhwɛ wo nuabarima Yoab anim.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Nanso, Asahel antie ara, enti Abner de ne pea no wɔɔ ne yafunu mu, maa pea no pue firii nʼakyi. Ɔbu hwee fam hɔ wuiɛ. Na obiara a ɔduruu atɔeɛ mu hɔ no gyinaa dinn hwɛɛ Asahel sɛ ɔda hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛberɛ a Yoab ne Abisai tee asɛm a asi no, wɔkɔɔ sɛ wɔrekɔhwehwɛ Abner. Ɛberɛ a wɔduruu Amma bepɔ a ɛbɛn Gia a ɛwɔ ɛkwan a ɛda hɔ kɔ Gibeon ɛserɛ so no, na onwunu adwo.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Abner akodɔm a wɔfiri Benyamin abusuakuo mu no boaa wɔn ho ano wɔ bepɔ no so yɛɛ krado maa ɔko.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛhɔ na Abner teaam, ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ, “Enti, ɛsɛ sɛ daa yɛfa akofena so de ka yɛn ntam asɛm anaa? Monnhunu sɛ, saa ɛkwan no de nitan bɛto yɛn ntam? Da bɛn na wobɛfrɛ wo mmarima no aka akyerɛ wɔn sɛ, wɔnnyae wɔn nuanom Israelfoɔ akyidie?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Yoab kaa sɛ, “Sɛ woankasa a anka, Onyankopɔn nko ara na ɔnim deɛ ɛbɛba; anka yɛbɛtaa wo anadwo mu no nyinaa.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Enti, Yoab hyɛn ne totorobɛnto, maa ne mmarima no gyaee Israel akodɔm no so taa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Anadwo mu no nyinaa, Abner ne ne mmarima nante kɔɔ Araba. Wɔtwaa Yordan bɔnhwa, toaa so kɔɔ Bitron, bɛduruu Mahanaim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Yoab gyaee Abner akyidie, na ɔboaboaa ne mmarima ano. Asahel akyi no, wɔhunuu sɛ Dawid mmarima no mu dunkron ayera.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Nanso, na Dawid mmarima no akunkum Benyaminfoɔ no mu nnipa ahansia ne aduosia a na wɔka Abner ho no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Wɔfaa Asahel siee no wɔ nʼagya ɔboda mu wɔ Betlehem. Na Yoab ne ne mmarima nantee anadwo mu no nyinaa kɔduruu Hebron adekyeeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Ntɔkwapɛni bi a wɔfrɛ no Seba na ɔyɛ Bikri a ɔfiri Benyamin babarima, hyɛnee totorobɛnto teaam sɛ,
  “Yɛne Dawid nni hwee yɛ.
    Yɛnni agyapadeɛ biara wɔ Yisai babarima no nkyɛn.
  Israel mmarima, mommra na yɛn nyinaa nkɔ yɛn kurom!”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Enti, Israel mmarima gyaa Dawid hɔ, kɔdii Seba akyi. Nanso, Yuda mmarima no deɛ, wɔtenaa wɔn ɔhene nkyɛn, na wɔwowaa no firi Asubɔnten Yordan ho, kɔsii Yerusalem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɛberɛ a ɔduruu nʼahemfie hɔ wɔ Yerusalem no, ɔhyɛɛ sɛ ne mpenafoɔ edu a ɔgyaa wɔn no, wɔmfa wɔn nkɔhyɛ kɔkoam baabi. Na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wɔn wɔn ahiadeɛ nyinaa, nanso ɔne wɔn nna bio. Enti, wɔn mu biara tenaa ase sɛ okunafoɔ, kɔsii ne wuda.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔhene no hyɛɛ Amasa sɛ ɔmfa nnansa mmoaboa Yuda akodɔm ano, na ɔmmɛka biribi nkyerɛ no saa ɛberɛ no mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Enti, Amasa kɔbɔɔ akodɔm no amaneɛ, nanso nʼahoboa no boroo nnansa no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abisai sɛ, “Saa ntɔkwapɛni Seba no rebɛha yɛn asene sɛ deɛ Absalom haa yɛn no. Ntɛm, fa mʼakodɔm no, na taa ne so ansa na wabɔ ne ho adwaa wɔ abanbɔeɛ nkuro no mu baabi a yɛn nsa renka no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Enti, Abisai ne Yoab yiyii awɛmfoɔ a wɔdi mu firii Yoab akodɔm ne ɔhene no ankasa deɛ mu de tii Seba.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na wɔduruu Gibeon ɔbo kɛseɛ no ho no, Amasa hyiaa wɔn. Na Yoab hyɛ nʼakotadeɛ a ɔde akofena abɔ nʼataaso. Ɔtuu nten kɔɔ nʼanim sɛ, ɔrekɔkyea Amasa pɛ, ɔyɛɛ nwaa twee akofena no firii bɔha mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Yoab bisaa no sɛ, “Me nua, wo ho te sɛn?” Ɛhɔ ara na Yoab de ne nsa nifa sɔɔ nʼabɔgyesɛ mu, sɛ deɛ ɔrefe nʼano.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Amasa anhunu sɛ akofena no hyɛ ne nsa benkum mu. Na Yoab de akofena no wɔɔ ne yam, maa ne nsono tu guu fam. Ɛho anhia sɛ Yoab bɛtia ne so koraa, na Amasa wuiɛ. Yoab ne ne nuabarima Abisai gyaa no hɔ, toaa so tii Bikri babarima Seba.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Yoab akodɔm no mu aberanteɛ a ɔyɛ panin wɔ akodɔm no so no mu baako teaam kyerɛɛ Amasa akodɔm no sɛ, “Obiara a ɔtaa Yoab akyi ne obiara a ɔwɔ Dawid afa no, ɔmmɛdi Yoab akyi.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Amasa daa ne mogyabura mu, wɔ ɛkwan no mfimfini. Na ɔbarima no hunuu sɛ akodɔm no aduru hɔ a wɔagyina rehwɛ Amasa no, ɔtwee no firii ɛkwan no mu, de no too wiram, de atadeɛ kataa ne so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Wɔyii Amasa firii ɛkwan no mu akyi no, mmarima no nyinaa dii Yoab akyi sɛ wɔrekɔkyere Bikri babarima Seba.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Saa ɛberɛ no, Seba kyinii Israel nyinaa boaboaa ne fiefoɔ Bikrifoɔ ano wɔ Abel-Bet-Maaka.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Yoab akodɔm no duruu hɔ no, wɔto hyɛɛ Abel-Bet-Maaka so. Wɔsisii epie wɔ kuro no akyi, de bɔɔ wɔn ho ban firii atamfoɔ ho na wɔpempem afasuo no, pɛɛ sɛ wɔdwiri guo.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Na ɔbaa nyansafoɔ bi teaam firi kuro no mu sɛ, “Montie! Montie! Monka nkyerɛ Yoab sɛ, ɔmmra ha, na menka asɛm bi nkyerɛ no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content:
Yoab kɔɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔbisaa no sɛ, “Wo na wɔfrɛ wo Yoab no?”
    Ɔbuaa sɛ, “Aane.”
    Ɔkaa sɛ, “Tie asɛm a wʼafenaa pɛ sɛ ɔka no.”
    Ɔbuaa sɛ, “Meretie.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɔkaa sɛ, “Tete no, na yɛka sɛ ‘Yɛrekɔpɛ afotuo wɔ Abel.’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Yɛpɛ asomdwoeɛ ne nokorɛ wɔ Israel. Wopɛ sɛ wosɛe kuro a adi nokorɛ wɔ Israel. Adɛn enti na wopɛ sɛ wosɛe ade a ɛyɛ Awurade dea?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Yoab buaa sɛ, “Ɛnyɛ sɛ mepɛ sɛ mesɛe wo kuropɔn.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content:
Deɛ merehwehwɛ no ara ne ɔbarima bi a ne din de Seba a ɔyɛ Bikri babarima a ɔfiri Efraim bepɔ so, na wama ne ho so atia ɔhene, ɔhene Dawid. Fa saa ɔbarima no bra, na mɛfiri kuro no mu.”
    Ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ, “Wɔbɛto ne ti afiri ɔfasuo no so ama wo.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Afei, ɔbaa no kɔkaa nʼafotu pa no kyerɛɛ nnipa no nyinaa. Na wɔtwaa Bikri babarima Seba ti, to maa Yoab. Enti, ɔhyɛnee totorobɛnto, maa ne mmarima no bɔ hweteeɛ, maa obiara kɔɔ ne fie. Na Yoab sane kɔɔ ɔhene nkyɛn wɔ Yerusalem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content:
Yoab bɛyɛɛ Dawid akodɔm so sahene bio.
    Na Yehoiada babarima Benaia nso yɛ ɔhene banbɔfoɔ so panin.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content:
Adorinam na na ɔhwɛ adwumayɛfoɔ so,
    na Yehosafat a ɔyɛ Ahilud babarima twerɛ ahemfo ho abakɔsɛm.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content:
Na Sewa yɛ asɛnniiɛ twerɛfoɔ.
    Na Sadok ne Abiatar nso yɛ asɔfoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Ɛnna Yairini Ira nso yɛ Dawid ɔsɔfoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 19-20

content: Dawid ahennie so no, ɛkɔm baa asase no so mfeɛ mmiɛnsa, enti Dawid bisaa Awurade ɛkɔm no ho asɛm. Na Awurade kaa sɛ, “Esiane ɛfɔ a Saulo ne ne fiefoɔ di wɔ kunkum a wɔkunkumm Gibeonfoɔ no ho enti na ɛkɔm saa aba no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Enti, ɔhene Dawid frɛɛ Gibeonfoɔ no nyinaa. Na wɔnka Israelfoɔ no ho, na mmom, wɔyɛ Amorifoɔ nkaeɛfoɔ bi. Israel kaa ntam sɛ, wɔrenkum wɔn, nanso ɛsiane Saulo ahopereɛ enti, ɔpɛɛ sɛ ɔtɔre wɔn ase.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Dawid bisaa Gibeonfoɔ no sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn na mɛtumi ayɛ de apata mo? Monka, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a Awurade bɛhyira ne nkurɔfoɔ bio.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Gibeonfoɔ no buaa sɛ, “Anokwa, sika rentumi, na yɛmpɛ nso sɛ wɔbɛkunkum Israelfoɔ aweretɔ so.”
    Enti, Dawid kɔɔ so bisaa wɔn sɛ, “Enti, ɛdeɛn na menyɛ? Monka nkyerɛ me, na mɛyɛ ama mo.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Na wɔbuaa sɛ, “Ɛyɛ Saulo na ɔdwenee ho sɛ ɔbɛsɛe yɛn, sɛdeɛ yɛrennya afa biara wɔ Israel.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Enti, wɔnyi Saulo mmammarima anaa ne nananom mmarima baason mma yɛn, na yɛbɛkum wɔn wɔ Awurade anim wɔ Gibea bepɔ no so.”
    Ɔhene no kaa sɛ, “Ɛyɛ. Mɛyɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22
