content: Dawid gyaee Yonatan babarima Mefiboset a na ɔyɛ Saulo nana no, ɛsiane ntam a na Dawid ne Yonatan aka wɔ Awurade anim no enti.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Nanso, ɔde Saulo mmammarima baanu a na wɔn edin de Armoni ne Mefiboset a na wɔn maame Rispa no yɛ Aia babaa maa wɔn. Ɔsane de Saulo babaa Mikal a na ɔyɛ Adriel a na ɔyɛ Barsilai a ɔfiri Mehola no yere mmammarima baanum no maeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Na Gibeon mmarima no kunkumm wɔn wɔ bepɔ no so wɔ Awurade anim. Enti, nnipa baason no nyinaa, wɔkunkumm wɔn wɔ ɛberɛ a wɔrefiri atokotwa afahyɛ no ase no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Rispa a ɔyɛ mmarima no mu baanu maame no de ayitoma sɛɛ ɔbotan bi so, tenaa hɔ otwaberɛ no nyinaa mu. Wamma apete ammɛtete wɔn amu no awiaberɛ mu, na anadwo nso, ɔsii nkekaboa ho kwan.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Ɛberɛ a Dawid tee deɛ Rispa a na ɔyɛ Saulo mpena no ayɛ no,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: ɔkɔɔ nkurɔfoɔ a wɔfiri Yabes Gilead nkyɛn, kɔbisaa wɔn Saulo ne ne babarima Yonatan nnompe ase. (Ɛberɛ a Saulo ne Yonatan totɔɔ ɔko a wɔne Filistifoɔ koeɛ no ano no, Yabes Gileadfoɔ na wɔkɔtasee wɔn amu Filistifoɔ kuro Bet-San abɔntene so.)

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Enti, Dawid de Saulo ne Yonatan nnompe baeɛ. Saa ara na ɔde mmarima a Gibeonfoɔ kunkumm wɔn no nnompe baeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Ɔsiee wɔn nyinaa wɔ Saulo agya Kis ɔboda a ɛwɔ kuro Sela a ɛwɔ Benyamin asase so no mu. Ɛno akyi, Onyankopɔn twaa ɛkɔm no so wɔ Israel asase so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Bio, Filistifoɔ ne Israel koeɛ. Na ɛberɛ a ɔko no duruu ne mpɔmpɔnsoɔ no, Dawid tɔɔ baha.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Na Yisbi-Benob yɛ abrane no asefoɔ mu baako. Na ne pea mu duru kari boro kilogram mmiɛnsa ne fa, a wɔde akofena foforɔ ahyehyɛ ne ho. Na waka Dawid ahyɛ a anka ɔrebɛkum no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Nanso, Seruia babarima Abisai bɛgyee Dawid, na ɔkumm Filistini no. Ɛno akyi, Dawid mmarima no kaa ntam sɛ, “Wo ne yɛn renkɔ ɔko bio. Anyɛ saa a, Israel kanea bɛdum.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Yei akyi, ɔko foforɔ ba de tiaa Filistifoɔ no wɔ Gob. Wɔgu so reko no, Sibekai a ɔfiri Husan, kumm Saf a na ɔno nso yɛ abrane no asefoɔ no bi.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Ɔko foforɔ bi a wɔkoo wɔ Gob no nso, Yair babarima Elhanan a ɔfiri Betlehem kumm Gatni Goliat nuabarima bi. Na ne pea nsa mu duru bɛyɛ sɛ ntomanwomfoɔ nsadua.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Ɔko bi a ɛsii bio wɔ Gat nso, ɔbarima tetetuo bi a na ɔyɛ nsansia ne nansia a ɔyɛ abrane no aseni no

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: pɛɛ sɛ ɔbu fa Israel so, gu nʼanim ase. Ɔno nso, Dawid nua Simea babarima Yonatan na ɔkumm no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Saa Filistifoɔ abrane baanan yi yɛ Gat abrane no asefoɔ. Na Dawid ne nʼakofoɔ na wɔkunkumm wɔn nyinaa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content: Ɛberɛ a Awurade gyee Dawid firii nʼatamfoɔ nyinaa ne Saulo nsam akyi no, ɔtoo saa dwom yi de yii Awurade ayɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Nsɛm a ɛwɔ dwom no mu nie:
  “Awurade yɛ me botan, mʼaban ne mʼagyenkwa;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
me Onyankopɔn yɛ me botan; ne mu na menya banbɔ.
  Ɔyɛ me kyɛm, me nkwagyeɛ mu ahoɔden ne me banbɔeɛ,
  mʼabantenten, mʼagyenkwa, deɛ ɔgye me firi basabasayɛ mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
“Mesu frɛ Awurade; ɔno na ayɛyie sɛ no,
    ɛfiri sɛ, ɔgye me firi mʼatamfoɔ nsam.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Owuo asorɔkye twaa me ho hyiaeɛ;
    ɔsɛeɛ yiri faa me so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Damena nhoma kyekyeree me;
    owuo ankasa too me anihaa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
“Na mʼamanehunu mu no, mesu mefrɛɛ Awurade.
    Aane, mefrɛɛ me Onyankopɔn pɛɛ mmoa.
  Ɔtee me nne firii ne kronkronbea.
    Me sufrɛ duruu nʼasom.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22
Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22
Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ɔfirii ɔsoro baa fam;
    na omununkum kabii duruu ne nan ase.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ɔte Kerubim so tuiɛ;
    gyaagyaa ne ho wɔ mframa ntaban so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ɔde sum kataa ne ho hyiaeɛ,
    ɔde osuo omununkum dii nʼanim ɛkan.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Hann kɛseɛ hyerɛn wɔ nʼanim,
    na anyinam pa firi mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Awurade bobɔɔ mu firi soro;
    Ɔsorosoroni no teaam denden.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ɔtoo nʼagyan maa nʼatamfoɔ hweteeɛ;
    anyinam dwaeɛ ma wɔyɛɛ basaa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Awurade kasaeɛ,
    na ewiase nnyinasoɔ no nyinaa daa hɔ.
  Wɔtumi hunuu ɛpo ase,
    na asase fapem ho daa hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
“Ɔfiri ɔsoro baa ɛfam bɛsɔɔ me mu;
    ɔtwee me firii nsuo a emu dɔ mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ɔgyee me firii mʼatamfoɔ a wɔyɛ den nsam,
    atamfoɔ a wɔkyiri me na wɔn ho yɛ den pa ara ma me.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Wɔbaa me so wɔ mʼamanehunu da mu,
    nanso Awurade pagyaa me.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ɔde me baa baabi a banbɔ wɔ;
    ɔgyee me, ɛfiri sɛ, nʼani ku me ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
“Awurade ne me adi no sɛdeɛ me tenenee teɛ;
    wahwɛ me nsa a ɛho teɛ so atua me ka.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ɛfiri sɛ, manante Awurade akwan so;
    Mentwee me ho mfirii me Onyankopɔn ho nkɔyɛɛ bɔne.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ne mmara nyinaa gu mʼanim;
    mentwee me ho mfirii ne nhyehyɛeɛ ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Me ho nni asɛm wɔ Onyankopɔn anim;
    matwe me ho afiri bɔne ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Awurade tuaa me papayɛ so ka,
  ɛfiri sɛ menni fɔ wɔ nʼanim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
“Woda wo ho adi sɛ ɔnokwafoɔ kyerɛ wɔn a wɔdi nokorɛ,
    wɔn a wɔdi mu nso wo kyerɛ wɔn sɛ wodi mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Woyi wo kronkronyɛ kyerɛ ɔkronkronni,
    nanso amumuyɛfoɔ deɛ wokyiri wɔn.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Wogye ahobrɛasefoɔ,
    nanso wʼani kɔ ahantanfoɔ so sɛ wobɛbrɛ wɔn ase.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ao Awurade, woyɛ me kanea.
    Aane, Awurade woma me sum dane hann.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Wʼahoɔden a wode ma me enti, metumi ka akodɔm gu;
    me Onyankopɔn enti, metumi foro ɔfasuo.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
“Onyankopɔn deɛ, nʼakwan yɛ pɛ;
    Awurade bɔhyɛ nyinaa ba mu.
  Ɔyɛ akokyɛm
    ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ banbɔ wɔ ne mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Hwan ne Onyankopɔn, gye sɛ Awurade?
    Hwan ne ɔbotantim no, gye sɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn?

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Onyankopɔn ne mʼaban a ɛyɛ den;
    wagye me, na wama me kwan so ayɛ pɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ɔma mʼanammɔn ho yɛ hare sɛ ɔforoteɛ deɛ;
    Ɔma me gyina sorɔnsorɔmmea.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ɔsiesie me ma ɔko;
    na mʼabasa tumi kuntunu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ tadua.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Woama me wo nkwagyeɛ kyɛm.
    Wo mmoa ama mayɛ ɔkɛseɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Woabɔ ɛkwan tɛtrɛɛ ama me nan
    sɛdeɛ ɛrenwatiri.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
“Metaa mʼatamfoɔ so sɛee wɔn;
    mannyina kɔsii sɛ wɔdii nkoguo.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Meyamoo wɔn, mebɔɔ wɔn hwee fam, na wɔantumi ansɔre;
    wɔhwehwee ase wɔ me nan ase.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Wohyɛɛ me ahoɔden maa ɔko;
    woaka mʼatamfoɔ ahyɛ me nan ase.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Womaa wɔdanee wɔn ani dwaneeɛ,
    na mesɛe wɔn a wɔtan me nyinaa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Wɔsu pɛɛ mmoa, nanso obiara ammɛgye wɔn.
    Wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade, nanso wannye wɔn so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Meyamoo wɔn ma wɔyɛɛ sɛ asase so mfuturo;
    mepraa wɔn guu nsuka mu sɛ wira.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22
Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ananafoɔ brɛ wɔn ho ase ma me;
    wɔte me nka pɛ ara a, wɔde wɔn ho ma me.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Wɔn nyinaa bɔ huboa,
    na wɔde ahopopoɔ firi wɔn nsraban mu ba.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
“Awurade te ase! Ayɛyi nka me botan,
    ma wɔmma Onyankopɔn, me nkwagyeɛ botan so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ɔno ne Onyankopɔn a ɔtɔ wɔn a wɔha me so awere;
    ɔka amanaman no hyɛ mʼase

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
na ɔgye me firi mʼatamfoɔ nsam.
  Wode me si baabi a mʼatamfoɔ nnuru,
    wogye me firi atutupɛfoɔ a wɔtia me nsam.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Ao Awurade yei enti, mɛkamfo wo wɔ amanaman mu nyinaa;
    na mɛto ayɛyie nnwom ama wo edin.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22
Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 21-22

content:
Yei ne Dawid nsɛm a ɛtwaa toɔ:
  “Dawid, Yisai ba barima a
    Onyankopɔn maa no nkɔsoɔ a ɛyɛ nwanwa,
  na Yakob Onyankopɔn sraa no ngo no,
    ne nnwomsiaani papa bi nie:

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
“Awurade honhom kasa fa me mu;
    ne nsɛm wɔ me tɛkrɛma so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Israel Onyankopɔn kasaeɛ,
    Israel botan ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:
  ‘Onipa a ɔdi ɔhene tenenee mu,
    na ɔde Nyamesuro di ɔhene no,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
ɔte sɛ anɔpa hann,
    ɔte sɛ owiapue a ɛhyerɛn ɛberɛ a omununkum nni hɔ;
  ɔte sɛ osutɔ a ɛma ahodwoɔ,
    na ɛma ɛserɛ foforɔ pue firi asase mu.’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
“Ɛyɛ me fie na Onyankopɔn ayi.
    Aane, ɔne me ayɛ apam a ɛwɔ hɔ daa.
  Ne nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ afebɔɔ, ebi nni hɔ bio, na wɔasɔ ano.
    Ɔbɛhwɛ me yiedie ne me nkɔsoɔ daa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Na wɔn a wɔnnim Onyame no te sɛ nkasɛɛ a wɔbɛto aguo,
    ɛfiri sɛ, wɔwowɔ nsa a ɛsɔ mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Ɛsɛ sɛ obi kɔ amia mu ansa na watwa wɔn agu;
    wɔde ogya bɛhye wɔn dworobɛɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Edin a ɛdidi soɔ yi yɛ Dawid nnɔmmarima:
    Deɛ ɔdi ɛkan ne Yoseb-Basebet a ɔfiri Tahkemon, na ɔyɛ ɔsahene wɔ akofoɔ akɛseɛ Baasa bi so wɔ Dawid mmarima no mu. Ɔno na ɔde ne pea kumm atamfoɔ akofoɔ aha nwɔtwe wɔ ɔsa baako pɛ mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu wɔ Baasa no mu no ne Dodo babarima Eleasa a ɔyɛ Ahohi aseni. Ɛberɛ bi Eleasa ne Dawid ka boom, te gyinaeɛ, de tiaa Filistifoɔ ɛberɛ a Israel akodɔm no nyinaa adwane.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Ɔkunkumm Filistifoɔ no ara kɔsii sɛ afei, na ɔntumi mpagya ne pea. Nanso, Awurade maa no dii nkonim saa da no. Akodɔm a aka no ansane amma, kɔsii ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkɔtase wɔn asadeɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Deɛ ɔdi hɔ yɛ Sama a ɔyɛ Agee a ɔfiri Harar babarima. Ɛda koro bi, Filistifoɔ no boaa wɔn ho ano wɔ Lehi, na wɔto hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no so asɛdua afuo bi mu. Israel akodɔm no dwaneeɛ,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: nanso, Sama gyinaa ne nan so pintinn wɔ afuo no mfimfini, kaa Filistifoɔ no guiɛ. Enti, Awurade ma ɔdii nkonim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Ɛberɛ bi, ɛduruu twaberɛ no a Dawid wɔ Adulam ɔbodan mu no, Filistia akodɔm bɛkyeree sraban wɔ Refaim bɔnhwa mu. Baasa no (a na wɔka Aduasa no ho no, wɔn a na wɔyɛ nimdefoɔ wɔ Dawid akofoɔ mu no) siane kɔhyiaa no wɔ hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Saa ɛberɛ no na Dawid te sraban mu hɔ a na Filistifoɔ akodɔm no fa bi nso akɔtena Betlehem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Dawid daa nʼakɔnnɔ adi sɛ, “Ao, sɛ menya nsu pa a ɛwɔ Betlehem abura a ɛwɔ kuro no ɛpono no ano hɔ no bi a, mɛnom.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Enti, Baasa no bu faa Filistifoɔ no mu kɔsaa nsuo no bi firii abura no mu, de brɛɛ Dawid. Nanso, wannom. Mmom, ɔhwie guu Awurade anim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Ɔteaam sɛ, “Awurade ma ɛmpare me sɛ mɛnom yei! Saa nsuo yi som bo te sɛ saa mmarima yi a wɔde wɔn nkwa too hɔ, kɔsaa nsuo yi brɛɛ me yi mogya.” Enti, Dawid annom. Aninsɛm a Baasa no yɛeɛ nhwɛsoɔ bi nie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Na Yoab nua Seruia babarima Abisai nso dii Aduasa no anim. Ɛda bi, ɔde ne pea kumm atamfoɔ akofoɔ ahasa wɔ ɔsa baako pɛ mu. Saa mmaninsɛm yi enti na ɔgyee edin te sɛ Baasa no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Abisai na ɔgyee edin pa ara wɔ Aduasa no mu. Ɛwom na ɔnka Baasa no ho deɛ, nanso na ɔno ne Aduasa no safohene.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Na Yehoiada babarima Benaia nso yɛ ɔkofoɔ kokodurufoɔ a ɔfiri Kabseel. Ɔdii aninsɛm bebree a ebi ne sɛ, ɔkumm Moab akofoɔ akɛseɛ baanu. Ɛberɛ bi nso, ɔtaa gyata, ma wɔkɔtɔɔ amena mu. Na sukyerɛmma atɔ, ama fam ayɛ toro deɛ, nanso ɔkyeree gyata no, kumm no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Ɛberɛ bi nso, na akontibaa na ɛkura no, nanso ɔde kumm Misraimni ɔkofoɔ kɛseɛ bi a na ɔno kura pea. Benaia hwam pea no firii Misraimni no nsam, na ɔde kumm no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Yeinom ne mmaninsɛm a ɛmaa Yehoiada babarima Benaia gyee edin te sɛ Baasa no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Na ɔwɔ animuonyam sene wɔn a na wɔfra Aduasa no mu, nanso na ɔnka Baasa no ho. Na Dawid yɛɛ no nʼawɛmfoɔ no so ɔsahene.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24
Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Sama a ɔfiri Harod;
    Elika a ɔfiri Harod;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Heles a ɔfiri Palti;
    Ira, Ikes a ɔfiri Tekoa babarima;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Abieser a ɔfiri Anatot;
    Sibekai a ɔfiri Husa;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Salmon a ɔfiri Ahoa;
    Maharai a ɔfiri Netofa;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Heleb, Baana a ɔfiri Netofa babarima;
    Itai, Ribai a ɔfiri Gibea (Benyamin abusuakuo mu) babarima;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Benaia a ɔfiri Piraton;
    Hidai a ɔfiri Nahale-Gaas;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Arbatini Abi-Albon;
    Asmawet a ɔfiri Bahurim;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Eliahba a ɔfiri Saalbon;
    Yaasen mmammarima;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Yonatan, Sama a ɔfiri Harar babarima;
    Sarar, Ahiam a ɔfiri Maaka babarima;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Elifelet, Ahasbai a ɔfiri Maaka babarima;
    Eliam, Ahitofel a ɔfiri Gilo babarima;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Hesro a ɔfiri Karmel;
    Paarai a ɔfiri Arba;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Igal, Natan a ɔfiri Soba babarima;
    Bani a ɔfiri Gad;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Selek a ɔfiri Amon;
    Naharai a ɔfiri Beerot (Yoab akodeɛkurafoɔ);

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Ira a ɔfiri Yitri;
    Gareb a ɔfiri Yitri;

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Hetini Uria.
    
    Wɔn nyinaa dodoɔ yɛ aduasa nson.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Bio, Awurade abufuo baa Israel so enti, ɔhyɛɛ Dawid sɛ ɔmfa nnipakan so nha wɔn a wɔwɔ Israel ne Yuda nyinaa. Awurade see Dawid sɛ, “Kɔ na kɔkan Israelfoɔ ne Yudafoɔ nyinaa.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Enti, ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ ne sahene Yoab sɛ, “Kan nnipa a wɔwɔ asase yi so nyinaa, ɛfiri Dan a ɛwɔ atifi fam, de bɛsi Beer-Seba a ɛwɔ anafoɔ fam, na ama mahunu nnipa dodoɔ a wɔwɔ ha.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Na Yoab buaa ɔhene no sɛ, “Awurade mma wo ntena ase kɔsi sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ wʼahennie yi mu ase bɛtrɛ mmɔho ɔha. Na adɛn enti na wopɛ sɛ woyɛ yei?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Na ɔhene no hyɛɛ no ketee sɛ, wɔnkan nnipa enti, Yoab ne nʼadwumayɛfoɔ kɔkanee nnipa a wɔwɔ Israel.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Deɛ ɛdi ɛkan no, wɔtwaa Yordan kɔtenaa Aroer, kuro a ɛwɔ bɔnhwa no anafoɔ a ɛkyerɛ Gad no. Afei, wɔkɔɔ Yaser,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: toaa so kɔduruu Gilead a ɛwɔ Tatim-hodsi, toaa so kɔɔ Dan Yaan ne Sidon fa mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Afei, wɔbaa Tiro aban mu ne Hewifoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ nkuropɔn nyinaa mu. Wɔkɔɔ Yuda anafoɔ, kɔduruu Beer-Seba de wieeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Wɔwurawuraa asase no nyinaa so, de abosome nkron ne nnafua aduonu wiee nnipakan no, sane kɔɔ Yerusalem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Yoab de ne nnipa dodoɔ a wɔnyaeɛ brɛɛ ɔhene no. Na mmarima a wɔaduru sraadie mfeɛ so wɔ Israel no dodoɔ yɛ mpem aha nwɔtwe, na mpem ahanum nso wɔ Yuda.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Dawid kan nnipa no nyinaa wieeɛ no, nʼatiboa buu no fɔ, enti ɔka kyerɛɛ Awurade sɛ, “Deɛ meyɛeɛ yi enti, mayɛ bɔne kɛseɛ. Enti, Awurade, mesrɛ wo, yi saa afɔbuo yi firi wo ɔsomfoɔ so. Mayɛ nkwaseadeɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Awurade asɛm baa odiyifoɔ Gad a ɔyɛ Dawid ɔdehunufoɔ nkyɛn sɛ:

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: “Kɔka kyerɛ Dawid sɛ, Sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie: ‘Mede nsɛm mmiɛnsa reto wʼanim. Yi mu baako na mɛyɛ.’ ”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Enti, Gad kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn kɔbisaa no sɛ, “Ɔkɔm mmra wʼasase yi so mfeɛ mmiɛnsa anaa? Anaa, atamfoɔ a wɔgu wo so no wobɛdwane wɔn abosome mmiɛnsa? Anaa, ɔyaredɔm mmra wo ɔman yi mu nnansa? Enti afei, dwene ho yie, na ma menhunu mmuaeɛ a memfa nkɔma Awurade.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Gad sɛ, “Yɛwɔ ahohiahia mu. Momma yɛmfa yɛn ho nhyɛ Awurade nsa, ɛfiri sɛ, nʼadɔeɛ dɔɔso; nanso, mma me nkɔtɔ nnipa nsam.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Enti, Awurade too ɔyaredɔm guu Israel so anɔpa no ma ɛdii nnansa. Na nnipa ɔpeduɔson firii Dan kɔsi Beer-Seba wuwuiɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Ɛberɛ a ɔbɔfoɔ no reyɛ ahoboa akɔsɛe Yerusalem no, Awurade nuu ne ho wɔ asɛm no ho, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Ɛyɛ! Gyae.” Saa ɛberɛ no na Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ no aduru Yebusini Arauna ayuporobea hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Ɛberɛ a Dawid hunuu ɔbɔfoɔ no, ɔka kyerɛɛ Awurade sɛ, “Me na mayɛ bɔne. Yeinom deɛ wɔnnim ho hwee, ɛdeɛn na wɔayɛ? Ma wo ɔbɔfoɔ nsɛe me ne me fiefoɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Ɛda no, Gad kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Kɔ na kɔsi afɔrebukyia ma Awurade wɔ Yebusini Arauna ayuporobea hɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Na Dawid kɔyɛɛ deɛ Awurade hyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Ɛberɛ a Arauna hunuu sɛ ɔhene ne ne mmarima reba no, ɔpueeɛ, bɛkotoo ɔhene, de nʼanim butuu fam.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Arauna bisaa sɛ, “Adɛn enti na woaba, me wura?”
    Dawid buaa sɛ, “Merebɛtɔ ayuporobea hɔ, na masi afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ ama Awurade, sɛdeɛ Awurade bɛma ɔyaredɔm no agyae.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Arauna ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ, “Me wura fa na fayɛ deɛ wopɛ. Nantwie a wɔde bɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nie. Wobɛtumi de ayuporeeɛ nnua ne nantwie mpamho nnua no ayɛ anyina wɔ afɔrebukyia no so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Mede ne nyinaa bɛma wo, na mesrɛ sɛ, Awurade, wo Onyankopɔn nnye afɔdeɛ yi.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content:
Na ɔhene no buaa Arauna sɛ, “Dabi, mepɛ sɛ mɛtɔ, na merentumi mmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mma Awurade, me Onyankopɔn, a mammɔ ho ka biara.”
    Enti, Dawid tuaa dwetɛ bɛyɛ gram ahanum aduɔson enum (575) de tɔɔ ayuporobea ne nantwie no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Dawid sii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ maa Awurade, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ hɔ. Na Awurade tiee ne mpaeɛbɔ maa ɔyaredɔm no gyaee.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 23-24

content: Ɔko a ɛbɛtɔɔ wɔn a wɔwɔ Saulo afa ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Dawid afa no kyɛree yie, na ne ahyɛaseɛ nie. Ɛberɛ a Dawid adedie renya ahoɔden no, na Saulo adedie no resɛe.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Yeinom ne Dawid mmammarima a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ Hebron:
    
    Nʼabakan no din de Amnon a ɔyɛ Ahinoam a ɔfiri Yesreel no babarima.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu no din de Kileab a ɔyɛ Abigail a na ɔyɛ Nabal a ɔfiri Karmel no kunabaa babarima;
    deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no din de Absalom a ɔyɛ Gesurhene Talmai babaa Maaka babarima.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Deɛ ɔtɔ so ɛnan no din de Adoniya a ɔyɛ Hagit babarima;
    deɛ ɔtɔ so enum no din de Sefatia a ɔyɛ Abital babarima.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nsia no din de Yitream a ɔyɛ Dawid yere Egla babarima.
    
    Wɔwoo saa mma yi maa Dawid wɔ Hebron.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛberɛ a na ɔko a ɛda Saulo fie ne Dawid fie no gu so no, na Abner yɛ ntuanoni a ɔwɔ tumi wɔ wɔn a wɔdi Saulo akyi no so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Emu hɔ Is-Boset bɔɔ Abner kwaadu sɛ ɔne nʼagya Saulo mpena a wɔfrɛ no Rispa, a ɔyɛ Aya babaa, ada.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Abner bo fuu yie kaa sɛ, “Meyɛ nkraman sodifoɔ wɔ Yuda na wɔadwoodwoo me saa? Deɛ mayɛ ama wo ne wʼagya, a mannyi mo amma Dawid no, mʼayɛyie ne sɛ, mode ɔbaa yi ho asɛm rekyekyere me?

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Sɛ mammoa Dawid ma ne nsa anka deɛ Awurade hyɛɛ ho bɔ no a, Onyankopɔn ne me nni no nwononwono.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Mede Saulo ahennie bɛkɔ akɔma Dawid na matim Dawid ahennwa ase wɔ Israel ne Yuda so afiri Dan akɔsi Beer-Seba.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Esiane sɛ na Is-Boset suro Abner enti, wantumi ankasa bio.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Afei, Abner tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Ma yɛnyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ na mɛboa ama yɛadane Israelman mu no nyinaa ama wo.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Dawid buaa sɛ, “Ɛyɛ asɛm papa, nanso me ne wo renyɛ saa nhyehyɛeɛ no gye sɛ, sɛ woreba a, wode me yere Mikal a ɔyɛ Saulo babaa no brɛ me.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Enti, Dawid soma ma wɔkɔbɔɔ Saulo babarima Is-Boset amaneɛ sɛ, “Ma me nsa nka me yere Mikal, ɛfiri sɛ, mede Filistifoɔ ɔha nkwa na ɛtɔɔ no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Enti, Is-Boset gyee Mikal firii ne kunu Paltiel a ɔyɛ Lais babarima no nsam.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Paltiel de su dii ɔbaa no akyi kɔduruu Bahurim. Na Abner ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Sane kɔ efie.” Na Paltiel sane kɔɔ efie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Abner ne Israel ntuanofoɔ adidi nkɔmmɔ. Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, “Mmerɛ kakra a atwam nie no, na mopɛ sɛ mosi Dawid ɔhene.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛberɛ no nie. Ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade aka sɛ, ‘Mayi Dawid sɛ ɔnnye me nkurɔfoɔ mfiri Filistifoɔ ne wɔn atamfoɔ nyinaa nsam.’ ”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Abner sane ne Benyamin abusua mu ntuanofoɔ kasaeɛ. Afei, ɔkɔɔ Hebron kɔbɔɔ Dawid amaneɛ sɛ, Israel nyinaa ne Benyamin taa wʼakyi.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛberɛ a Abner ne ne mmarima aduonu baa Hebron no, Dawid too wɔn ɛpono kɛseɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Abner ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ, “Ma menkɔ na menkɔfrɛ Israel nnipa nyinaa na wɔmmra wʼafa. Wɔne wo bɛyɛ apam, na wɔasi wo ɔhene. Na ɛbɛma woadi biribiara a wʼakoma pɛ so.” Enti, Dawid maa Abner kɔɔ dwoodwoo.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Abner kɔeɛ ara pɛ, Yoab ne Dawid akodɔm no bi firi ɔsa mu baeɛ a wɔkura asadeɛ bebree.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛberɛ a wɔka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ Abner baa hɔ nkyɛree koraa, na ɔbɛsraa ɔhene, ama ɔhene ama no kɔ asomdwoeɛ mu no,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Yoab yɛɛ ntɛm kɔhunuu ɔhene bisaa no sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yi? Abner kɔ a womaa no kɔeɛ yi, wokyerɛ sɛn?

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Wonim pefee sɛ, ɔbaa wo so sɛ ɔkwansrafoɔ, bɛhwehwɛɛ deɛ woreyɛ nyinaa mu anaa?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛhɔ ara, Yoab firi Dawid nkyɛn, na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ sɛ wɔnti Abner. Wɔkɔtoo no Sira ɔtadeɛ ho, twee no de no baeɛ. Nanso, na Dawid nnim ho hwee.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Afei, Abner sane kɔɔ Hebron no, Yoab frɛɛ no kɔɔ nkyɛn kɔsii ɛpono ano te sɛ deɛ ɔrekɔka kɔkoamsɛm akyerɛ no no. Na ɛhɔ no na ɛsiane sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔtɔ ne nuabarima Asahel so wedeɛ no enti, Yoab wɔɔ Abner yafunu mu sekan ma ɔwuiɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Akyire no a Dawid tee saa asɛm yi no, ɔkaa sɛ, “Me ne mʼahemman nnim saa asɛm a ɛfa Abner yi ho hwee wɔ Awurade anim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ne mogya ngu Yoab ne nʼagya fie so! Yoab efie deɛ, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu nyinaa, obi a watutu akuro anaa ɔyare kwata, deɛ ɔnam poma ho nanteɛ anaa deɛ ɔwu akofena ano ne deɛ ɔsrɛsrɛ aduane rempa hɔ da.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Yoab ne ne nuabarima Abisai kumm Abner, ɛfiri sɛ, Abner kumm wɔn nuabarima Asahel wɔ akono wɔ Gibeon.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Yoab ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa sɛ, “Monsunsuane mo ntoma mu, na momfira ayitoma. Montwa Abner agyaadwoɔ.” Na ɔhene Dawid ankasa dii santen a wɔato no akyi, kɔɔ ɛda no so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Wɔsiee Abner wɔ Hebron, na ɔhene Dawid ne nnipa no nyinaa suu wɔ ne damena no ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content:
Afei, ɔhene too saa kwadwom yi maa Abner:
  “Ɛsɛ sɛ Abner wu sɛdeɛ nkwaseafoɔ wuo anaa?

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39
Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛda a wɔreyɛ ayie no, Dawid annidi da mu no nyinaa, maa afei, obiara srɛɛ no sɛ ɔnnidi. Nanso, na Dawid aka ntam sɛ, “Sɛ medidi ansa na owia akɔtɔ a, Onyankopɔn nku me.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Yei sɔɔ nnipa no ani yie. Nokorɛm, biribiara a ɔhene no yɛeɛ no sɔɔ ɔmanfoɔ no ani.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Yei maa obiara a ɔte Yuda ne Israel no hunuu sɛ, ɛnyɛ ɔhene Dawid na ɔkumm Abner.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na ɔhene Dawid bisaa ɔmanfoɔ no sɛ, “Monhunu sɛ ɔkannifoɔ kɛseɛ ne onipa kɛseɛ atɔ fam ɛnnɛ wɔ Israel anaa?

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Na ɛwom sɛ me ne ɔhene a wɔasra no deɛ, nanso Seruia mmammarima Yoab ne Abisai deɛ, wɔyɛ den dodo ma me sɛ mɛtumi aka wɔn ahyɛ. Ɛno enti, Awurade ntua saa mmarima amumuyɛfoɔ yi so ka wɔ wɔn amumuyɛsɛm ho.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:1-3:39

content: Ɛberɛ a Is-Boset tee sɛ Abner awu wɔ Hebron no, ne bo tuiɛ, na saa ara nso na ne nkurɔfoɔ no bɔɔ huboa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Afei, na anuanom baanu a wɔn din de Baana ne Rekab na na wɔyɛ asafohene ma Is-Boset akofoɔ no. Na wɔyɛ Rimon a ɔfiri Benyamin efie wɔ Beerot kuro mu no mmammarima. Seesei, na kuro Beerot ka Benyamin ho,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: ɛfiri sɛ, wɔn a na wɔte Beerot dadaada no dwane kɔɔ Gitaim a wɔda so te hɔ sɛ ahɔhoɔ de bɛsi ɛnnɛ yi.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Na Saulo babarima Yonatan wɔ ɔbabarima bi a ne din de Mefiboset a na ɔyɛ obubuafoɔ firi ne mmɔfraase. Wɔkumm Saulo ne Yonatan wɔ Yesreel akono no, na abɔfra no adi mfeɛ enum. Ɛberɛ a ɔko no ho asɛm duruu kuro no mu no, obi a ɔhwɛ abɔfra no kyekyeree no de no dwaneeɛ. Nanso, ɛberɛ a ɔredwane no, ɔhwee ase maa abɔfra no bɔɔ fam, ma ɔyɛɛ obubuafoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Dabi Beerotni, Rimon mmammarima baanu a wɔn din de Rekab ne Baana kɔɔ Is-Boset fie awia berɛ mu a na ɔregye nʼahome.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Ɛpono ano hwɛfoɔ a na ɔreporo ayuo no, na wada. Enti Rekab ne Baana twaa ne ho kɔɔ Is-Boset pia mu, kɔwɔɔ ne yafunu mu sekan, na wɔdwaneeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Ansa na wɔbɛkɔ no, wɔtwaa ne ti ɛberɛ a ɔda ne mpa so. Wɔfaa ne ti no kɔtwaa Yordan bɔnhwa no, nantee anadwo mu no nyinaa kɔeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Wɔde Is-Boset tire no brɛɛ Dawid wɔ Hebron, na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ, “Wo ɔtamfoɔ Saulo a anka ɔrepɛ wo akum wo no babarima Is-Boset tire nie. Ɛnnɛ, Awurade ama me wo aweretɔ ho kwan atia Saulo ne nʼabusua.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Na Dawid buaa Beerotni Rimon mma Rekab ne ne nua Baana sɛ, “Mmerɛ dodoɔ a Awurade a ɔgyee me firi ɔhaw ne abɛbrɛsɛ mu te ase yi, mɛka nokorɛ akyerɛ mo.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Ɛberɛ a onipa bi bɛka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Saulo awu’ a na ɔdwene sɛ ɔreka asɛm pa akyerɛ me no, mekyeree no kumm no wɔ Siklag. Nʼasɛm a ɔbɛka kyerɛɛ me no so akatua a mede maa no ne no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Na akatua bɛn na memfa mma amumuyɛfoɔ a wɔakum obi a ne ho nni asɛm wɔ ne fie ɛberɛ a ɔda ne mpa so. Ɛnsɛ sɛ mebisa ne mogya firi mo nsam anaa?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Enti, Dawid hyɛɛ ne mmarima ma wɔkunkumm wɔn. Wɔtwitwaa wɔn nsa ne wɔn nan, na wɔde kuntunsini no sensɛn Hebron ɔtadeɛ ho. Na wɔfaa Is-Boset tire no kɔsiee no wɔ Abner ɔboda mu wɔ Hebron.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Afei, Israel mmusuakuo no nyinaa kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn wɔ Hebron kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Yɛn nyinaa yɛ wʼabusuafoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Mmerɛ bi a atwam no a mpo na Saulo yɛ yɛn ɔhene no, wo ara na wodii Israel anim. Na Awurade aka akyerɛ wo sɛ, ‘Wobɛyɛ me manfoɔ Israel so odwanhwɛfoɔ. Wobɛyɛ wɔn kannifoɔ.’ ”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Enti Hebron hɔ, Dawid ne Israel ntuanofoɔ no yɛɛ apam wɔ Awurade anim. Na wɔsraa no ngo sii no Israelhene.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Dawid dii adeɛ no, na wanya mfirinhyia aduasa. Na ɔdii adeɛ mfirinhyia aduanan.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Ɔtenaa Hebron dii adeɛ wɔ Yuda so mfirinhyia nson ne abosome nsia. Na ɔtenaa Yerusalem no nso, ɔdii Israel ne Yuda nyinaa so ɔhene mfirinhyia aduasa mmiɛnsa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Dawid dii nʼakodɔm anim kɔɔ Yerusalem kɔko tiaa Yebusifoɔ. Yebusifoɔ no dii wɔn ho fɛ sɛ, “Morentumi mma ha. Na mpo, anifirafoɔ ne mmubuafoɔ bɛtu mo afiri ha.” Ɛfiri sɛ, na Yebusifoɔ no dwene sɛ wɔwɔ banbɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Nanso, Dawid ko faa Sion aban no a seesei wɔfrɛ no Dawid Kuropɔn no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Ɛberɛ a atɛnnidie nkra firi banbɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ kuro no mu duruu Dawid asom no, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne dɔm no sɛ, “Momfa nsudorobɛn no mu nkɔ kuro no mu, na monkɔsɛe Yebusifoɔ mpakye ne anifirafoɔ no, ɛfiri sɛ mekyiri wɔn! ‘Anifirafoɔ ne mpakye’ nnkɔ efie no mu” no abɔseɛ nie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Enti, Dawid yɛɛ aban no nʼatenaeɛ, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Dawid Kuropɔn. Ɔsisii banbɔdan bebree twaa kuro no ho kaa ho. Wɔhyɛɛ dwumadie no ase wɔ Milo de baa mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Na Dawid kɔɔ so yɛɛ kɛseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, Asafo Awurade Onyankopɔn ka ne ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Afei, Tirohene Huram somaa abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn a nnua dwumfoɔ ne aboɔ adansifoɔ ka wɔn ho sɛ wɔnkɔsi ahemfie mma no. Huram de ntweneduro nnua bebree kɔɔ hɔ sɛ wɔmpae.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Na Dawid hunuu sɛ, ne nkurɔfoɔ Israelfoɔ enti, Awurade asi no ɔhene, na wayɛ nʼahemman kɛseɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Dawid tu firi Hebron baa Yerusalem no, ɔwaree mmaa bebree faa mpenafoɔ nso. Ɛno enti, ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa bebree.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Yeinom ne Dawid mmammarima a wɔwowoo wɔn wɔ Yerusalem no: Samua, Sobab, Natan, Salomo

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Yibhar, Elisua, Nefeg, Yafia

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Elisama, Eliada ne Elifelet.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Ɛberɛ a Filistifoɔ tee sɛ wɔasra Dawid, de no asi Israelhene no, wɔboaboaa wɔn akodɔm ano, kɔhwehwɛɛ Dawid sɛ wɔbɛnya no akye no. Na Dawid teeɛ no, ɔno nso kɔɔ ne banbɔeɛm.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Afei, Filistifoɔ no bɛduruu Refaim bɔnhwa mu, na wɔtrɛtrɛɛ wɔn ho mu wɔ hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content:
Enti, Dawid bisaa Awurade sɛ, “Menkɔto nhyɛ Filistifoɔ yi so anaa? Wobɛdane wɔn ahyɛ me nsa anaa?”
    Awurade buaa no sɛ, “Aane, kɔ na mɛdane Filistifoɔ no ahyɛ wo nsa.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Enti, Dawid kɔɔ Baal-Perasim, na ɛhɔ na ɔdii Filistifoɔ no so nkonim. Ɔkaa sɛ, “Awurade ayɛ! Ɔbɔ wuraa mʼatamfoɔ no mu sɛ nsuyire a ɛreworo so!” Enti Dawid too beaeɛ hɔ din sɛ Baal-Perasim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Filistifoɔ no gyaa wɔn ahoni wɔ hɔ, maa Dawid ne ne mmarima no soaa ne nyinaa kɔeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Filistifoɔ no sane baa bio bɛhwetee wɔn ho mu wɔ Refaim bɔnhwa ho,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: enti, Dawid bisaa Awurade deɛ ɔnyɛ. Awurade buaa sɛ, “Nkɔ tee, mmom, twa fa wɔn ho wɔ wɔn akyi, na to hyɛ wɔn so wɔ baka nnua no anim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Na sɛ wote nnyegyeeɛ te sɛ nsrabɔ bi wɔ baka nnua no atifi a, kɔtua wɔn! Ɛkyerɛ sɛ, Awurade atu di wʼanim rekɔkunkum Filistifoɔ no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Enti, Dawid yɛɛ deɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no no, na ɔsɛee Filistifoɔ no firi Geba de kɔsii Geser.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-5:25

content: Na Dawid boaboaa akodɔm sononko ɔpeduasa ano.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Ɔdii wɔn anim firi Baala a ɛwɔ Yuda, sɛ wɔrekɔfa Onyankopɔn Adaka a ɛkura Awurade Otumfoɔ no a wɔde no asi Kerubim ntam no din.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Wɔde Onyankopɔn Adaka no sii teaseɛnam foforɔ so, de firii Abinadab fie a na ɛwɔ bepɔ so no baeɛ. Usa ne Ahio a na wɔyɛ Abinadab mmammarima no na na wɔkyerɛ teaseɛnam foforɔ no

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: a na Onyankopɔn Adaka no si mu no kwan. Na Ahio na ɔdi animu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Dawid ne Israel manfoɔ gyee wɔn ani wɔ Awurade anim wɔ ahoɔden so a wɔreto nnwom, na wɔde nsankuo, bɛnta, akasaeɛ, mfirikyiwa ne kyankyan nenam mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Na wɔduruu Nakon ayuporobea no, nantwie no nan totoeɛ, maa Usa tenee ne nsa sɔɔ Onyankopɔn Adaka no mu sɛ ɔretene no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Na Awurade bo fuu Usa sɛ ɔyɛɛ saa, na Onyankopɔn bɔɔ no, maa ɔwu daa adaka no ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Dawid nso bo fuiɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade abufuo atia Usa. Ɔtoo saa beaeɛ hɔ edin Peres-Usa a aseɛ ne abufuhyeɛ a ɛtia Usa. Wɔfrɛ hɔ saa ara de bɛsi ɛnnɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Afei, na Dawid suro Awurade enti ɔbisaa sɛ, “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mɛtumi de Awurade adaka no aba me nkyɛn, na mahwɛ so?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Na Dawid yɛɛ nʼadwene sɛ, ɔremma Awurade Adaka no so nkɔ Dawid Kuropɔn no mu. Na mmom, ɔmaa so de kɔɔ Obed-Edom a ɔyɛ Gatni fie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Na Awurade adaka no sii Gatni Obed-Edom fiefoɔ nkyɛn abosome mmiɛnsa, na Awurade hyiraa no ne ne fidua mu nnipa nyinaa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Afei, wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene Dawid sɛ, “Esiane Awurade Adaka no enti, Awurade ahyira Obed-Edom fie ne biribiara a ɔwɔ so.” Enti, Dawid kɔɔ hɔ kɔfaa Adaka no, de osebɔ kɛseɛ baa Dawid Kuropɔn no mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Nnipa a Awurade Adaka no so wɔn no tuu anammɔn nsia pɛ, wɔgyinaa hɔ twɛneeɛ, sɛdeɛ Dawid bɛtumi de nantwie ne nantwie ba a wadɔre sradeɛ abɔ afɔdeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Na Dawid firii nʼahoɔden nyinaa mu saa wɔ Awurade anim a na ɔhyɛ asɔfotadeɛ yuu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Enti, Dawid ne Israel nyinaa de nteateam ne ntotorobɛntohyɛn maa Awurade Adaka no so kɔɔeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Ɛberɛ a wɔde Awurade Adaka no rewura Dawid Kuropɔn no mu no, Saulo babaa a ne din de Mikal no kɔtɛɛ mpomma mu hwɛeɛ. Ɔhunuu sɛ ɔhene Dawid rehurihuri, resa anigyeɛ so wɔ Awurade anim no, nʼani annye.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Wɔde Awurade Adaka no kɔsii nʼafa wɔ ntomadan a ɛno enti, Dawid asi no mu, na Dawid bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ Awurade anim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Ɔwieeɛ no, ɔhyiraa nnipa no wɔ Awurade Otumfoɔ din mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Afei, ɔmaa Israel dɔm no mu nnipa biara burodo mua, nankum ne bobe aba ɔfam. Na wɔn mu biara kɔɔ ne fie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Ɛberɛ a Dawid sane kɔɔ ne fie sɛ ɔrekɔhyira ne fiefoɔ no, Mikal firii adi ba bɛhyiaa no ka kyerɛɛ no abufuo so sɛ, “Ɛnnɛ deɛ, na Israelhene nsɛ ha! Ɔpaa ne ho kyerɛɛ ne mfenaa te sɛ deɛ obiara a ɔmmu ne ho bɛyɛ no ara pɛ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Dawid buaa Mikal sɛ, “Na meresa wɔ Awurade a ɔyii me, na ɔtwaa wʼagya ne nʼabusuafoɔ gyaeɛ no anim. Ɔyii me sɛ menyɛ Israel a wɔyɛ Awurade nkurɔfoɔ ɔkannifoɔ. Ɛno enti, ɛyɛ me pɛ sɛ meyɛ me ho sɛ ɔkwasea, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛma makyerɛ mʼahokeka a mewɔ wɔ Awurade mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Aane, na mepɛ sɛ meyɛ ɔkwasea koraa sene yei, na mmaayewa korɔ yi ara a woreka wɔn ho asɛm yi bɛhyɛ me animuonyam.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Na Saulo babaa Mikal anwo ba da wɔ ne nkwa nna nyinaa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-23

content: Ɛberɛ a wɔbɔɔ ɔhene no atenaseɛ wɔ nʼahemfie na Awurade ama asomdwoeɛ aba asase no so no,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Dawid frɛɛ nkɔmhyɛni Natan sɛ, “Hwɛ, mete ahemfie a wɔde ntweneduro asi mu, na Onyankopɔn Adaka no nso si ntomadan mu.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Na Natan buaa ɔhene no sɛ, “Biribiara a woadwene ho sɛ wobɛyɛ no, kɔ so na yɛ, na Awurade ka wo ho.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Na anadwo no, Awurade asɛm baa Natan so sɛ,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: “Kɔka kyerɛ me ɔsomfoɔ Dawid sɛ, ‘Sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie: Wone obi a ɛsɛ sɛ wosi ɛdan ma me na metena mu anaa?

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Ɛfiri ɛberɛ a mede Israelfoɔ firi Misraim baeɛ de bɛsi ɛnnɛ no, mentenaa ɛdan mu da. Daa wɔtu mʼase firi beaeɛ kɔ beaeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Ɛberɛ biara a wɔtu mʼase a Israelman nyinaa ka me ho no, motee sɛ mebisaa wɔn sodifoɔ, wɔn a mehyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ me nkurɔfoɔ Israelfoɔ no sɛ, “Adɛn enti na momfaa ntweneduro nsii fie mmaa me da?” ’

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: “Afei, kɔka kyerɛ me ɔsomfoɔ Dawid sɛ, ‘Sɛdeɛ Awurade Otumfoɔ seɛ nie: Meyii wo firii mmoa adidibea ne nnwan akyidie mu, de wo bɛsii me nkurɔfoɔ Israel so ɔhene.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Na baabiara a wokɔ no, meka wo ho, na matwa wʼatamfoɔ nyinaa afiri wʼanim. Na mɛma wɔagye din wɔ asase yi nyinaa so.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Na mapɛ tenaberɛ ama me nkurɔfoɔ Israel; beaeɛ bi a ɛwɔ banbɔ a obiara renha wɔn. Ɛhɔ bɛyɛ wɔn ankasa asase a aman amumuyɛfoɔ renhyɛ wɔn so, sɛdeɛ wɔyɛɛ wɔ ɛberɛ bi a atwam no,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content:
ɛfiri ɛberɛ a mepaa atemmufoɔ sɛ wɔnni me nkurɔfoɔ so no. Mɛsane ama mo banbɔ afiri mo atamfoɔ nyinaa nsam.
    “ ‘Na Awurade aka akyerɛ wo sɛ, ɔno Awurade na ɔbɛkyekyere efie ama wo; ahemfo ntoatoasoɔ efie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Na sɛ wo nna to twa a, mɛma wʼaseni a ɔfiri wʼasenem adi wʼadeɛ, na matim nʼahemman ase.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Ɔno ne obi a ɔbɛsi dan de me din ato so. Na matim nʼahemman mu ahennwa ase afebɔɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Mɛyɛ nʼagya, na wayɛ me ba. Sɛ ɔyɛ bɔne a, mɛma aman bi atwe nʼaso.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Nanso, merenyi me dɔ mfiri ne so da, sɛdeɛ meyi mefirii Saulo a meyii no firii wʼanim no so ansa na wobɛdii nʼadeɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Wo fie ne wʼahemman bɛtim wɔ mʼanim afebɔɔ; na wʼahennwa bɛtena hɔ daa.’ ”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Natan kaa saa adiyisɛm yi nyinaa kyerɛɛ Dawid.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content:
Na ɔhene Dawid kɔtenaa Awurade anim bɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ,
    “Ao, Awurade Otumfoɔ, mene hwan, na me fiefoɔ yɛ ɛdeɛn a wode me abɛduru ɛnnɛ?

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Na afei Otumfoɔ Awurade, yeinom nyinaa akyi no, woka sɛ wobɛma me ahennie a ɛte hɔ daa. Woyɛ nnipa nyinaa sei anaa, Ao Awurade Otumfoɔ?

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: “Ɛdeɛbɛn bio na mɛtumi aka? Ɛfiri sɛ, wonim sɛdeɛ wʼakoa teɛ, Ao Awurade Otumfoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Wʼasɛm ne wo pɛ mu enti, woayɛ nneɛma kɛseɛ yi nyinaa akyerɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: “Wo kɛseyɛ yɛ kokuroo, Ao Awurade Otumfoɔ! Obi biara nte sɛ wo, Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ sɛ wo, na yɛntee onyame foforɔ bi mpo ho asɛm!

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Ɔman bɛn na ɛwɔ asase yi so a ɛte sɛ Israel? Ɔman foforɔ bɛn na woayi no afiri nkoasom mu de wɔn ayɛ wo ɔman? Ɛberɛ a woyii wo nkurɔfoɔ firii Misraim no, wogyee edin. Woyɛɛ anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ de pamoo aman ne ahoni ahodoɔ a na wɔyɛ akwansideɛ ma wo nkurɔfoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Woatim wo nkurɔfoɔ Israel sɛ wʼankasa wʼadeɛ afebɔɔ, na wo Ao Awurade, woabɛyɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: “Na afei, Awurade Onyankopɔn, di ɛbɔ a wohyɛ faa wʼakoa ne ne mʼabusuafoɔ ho no so. Ma ɛnyɛ bɔhyɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Na ma wo din nkron afebɔɔ na ewiase nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Awurade Otumfoɔ yɛ Israel so Onyankopɔn.’ Na ma wo ɔsomfoɔ Dawid ahennie ase ntim wɔ wʼanim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: “Ao, Awurade Otumfoɔ, Israel Onyankopɔn, masi me bo abɔ saa mpaeɛ yi ɛfiri sɛ woakyerɛ sɛ wobɛkyekyere fie a ɛyɛ daa ahennie ama me.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Ao, Awurade Otumfoɔ, woyɛ Onyankopɔn! Wo nsɛm mu wɔ ahotosoɔ, na woahyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ nnepa ho bɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Afei, ma ɛnyɛ wo pɛ sɛ wobɛhyira wʼakoa fie so, na atoa so afebɔɔ wɔ wʼanim, na wo, Ao Awurade Otumfoɔ, woakasa, na wo nhyira a wode bɛhyira wo ɔsomfoɔ fie no bɛyɛ daapem nhyira.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7:1-29

content: Akyire yi, Dawid dii Filistifoɔ no so, brɛɛ wɔn ase. Ɔko gyee Gat a ɛyɛ wɔn kuropɔn kɛseɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Dawid sane dii Moabfoɔ so. Ɔmaa nnipa no dedaa fam, na ɔde ahoma susuu wɔn. Ɔsusu ahoma no mmienu a, na wakyerɛ sɛ wɔnkum saa nnipa no. Ɛnna ɔsusu ahoma no baako a, na wakyerɛ sɛ wɔnnyaa saa nkurɔfoɔ no. Enti, Moabfoɔ a wɔnyaa wɔn ti didii mu no bɛyɛɛ Dawid asomfoɔ a na afe biara wɔyi ɛtoɔ brɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Dawid sɛe Rehob babarima Hadadeser a na ɔdi ɔhene wɔ Soba no akɔdɔm, ɛberɛ a Hadadeser kɔɔ Asubɔnten Eufrate ho, pɛɛ sɛ ɔkɔhyɛ ne nnisoɔ mu den.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Dawid kyeree ne nteaseɛnam apem, nteaseɛnamkafoɔ mpem nson ne nammɔntwa asraafoɔ ɔpeduonu. Dawid twitwaa nteaseɛnam apɔnkɔ no nyinaa nantin ntini, ma ɛkaa ɔha pɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Ɛberɛ a Aramfoɔ a wɔfiri Damasko baa sɛ wɔrebɛboa Sobahene Hadadeser no, Dawid kumm wɔn mu ɔpeduonu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Na ɔde akodɔm a wɔyɛ bansifoɔ kɔtenaa Damasko, ma Aramfoɔ bɛyɛɛ Dawid nkurɔfoɔ a na wɔyi toɔ brɛ no. Baabiara a Dawid bɛkɔ no, Awurade ma no di nkonim.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Dawid faa sikakɔkɔɔ nkuruwa a na ɛyɛ Hadadeser mpanimfoɔ dea no de ne nyinaa kɔɔ Yerusalem.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Ɔde Beta ne Berotai a na ɛyɛ Hadadeser nkuro no mu kɔbere bebree kaa ne ho kɔɔeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Ɛberɛ a Hamathene Toi tee sɛ Dawid atɔre Hadadeser akodɔm no ase pasaa no,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: ɔsomaa ne babarima Yoram wɔ Dawid nkyɛn, bɛkyiaa no maa no amo. Na Hadadeser ne Toi yɛ atamfoɔ firi teteete a wɔako atia wɔn ho mpɛn bebree. Yoram kɔkyɛɛ Dawid nneɛma bebree a ɛyɛ, dwetɛ, sikakɔkɔɔ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Ɔhene Dawid too akyɛdeɛ no nyinaa din de maa Awurade a, dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ a ɔnya firii aman bi a ɔdii wɔn so no nyinaa ka ho.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Saa aman no ne Edom, Moab, Amon, Filistia, Amalek ne deɛ ɛfiri Sobahene Rehob babarima Hadadeser nkyɛn nso.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Yei maa Dawid gyee edin. Ɔsane nʼakyi kɔeɛ no, ɔkunkumm Edomfoɔ mpem dunwɔtwe wɔ Nkyene Bɔnhwa mu.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Ɔde akodɔm bansifoɔ siisii Edom nyinaa ano. Na Edomfoɔ nyinaa bɛyɛɛ Dawid nkoa. Yei yɛ nhwɛsoɔ foforɔ a ɛkyerɛɛ nkonim a Awurade maa Dawid dii no baabiara a ɔkɔeɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Dawid dii Israel nyinaa so ɔhene, na ɔne obiara tenaa yie.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Seruia babarima Yoab na na ɔyɛ ɔsafohene. Ahilud babarima Yehosafat na na ɔyɛ adehyeɛ abakɔsɛmtwerɛni.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Sadok a na ɔyɛ Ahitub babarima ne Abiatar babarima Ahimelek na na wɔyɛ asɔfoɔ. Na Seraia yɛ asɛnniiɛ twerɛfoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Yehoiada babarima Benaia na na ɔdi Keretifoɔ ne Peletifoɔ so, ɛnna Dawid mmammarima tua asɔfodɔm ano.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Ɛda bi, Dawid pɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛhunu sɛ obi aka wɔ Saulo fie anaa. Ɛfiri sɛ na wahyɛ Yonatan bɔ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔn adɔeɛ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content:
Ɔfrɛɛ ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Siba a na anka ɔfra Saulo asomfoɔ mu. Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ, “Wo na wɔfrɛ wo Siba no anaa?”
    Ɔbuaa no sɛ, “Aane, mene Siba no.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content:
Ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ, “Obi aka wɔ Saulo efie anaa? Sɛ ɛte saa a mepɛ sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn adɔeɛ a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn wɔ ɛkwan biara a mɛtumi so.”
    Siba buaa ɔhene sɛ, “Yonatan babarima obubuafoɔ bi da so wɔ hɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content:
Ɔhene bisaa sɛ, “Ɔwɔ he?”
    Siba buaa sɛ, “Ɔwɔ Amiel babarima Makir fie wɔ Lo-debar.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Na ɔhene Dawid ma wɔkɔfaa no firii Amiel babarima Makir fie wɔ Lo-debar, de no brɛɛ no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Ne din de Mefiboset, a ɔyɛ Yonatan babarima ne Saulo nana. Ɔbaa Dawid anim no, ɔde ahopopoɔ kotoo no, kaa sɛ, “Meyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Nsuro, na deɛ ɛbɛyɛ biara no, ɛsiane wʼagya Yonatan enti, mɛyɛ wo adɔeɛ. Nsase a na ɛyɛ wo nana Saulo agyapadeɛ no nyinaa, mɛsane mede mama wo, na woadidi me didipono so daa daa.”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Mefiboset bɔɔ ne mu ase kaa sɛ, “Hwan ne me, ɔkraman funu a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ me saa adɔeɛ yi?”

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Ɔhene frɛɛ ne ɔsomfoɔ Siba, ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Mede biribiara a na ɛyɛ Saulo ne ne fiefoɔ agyapadeɛ no nyinaa ama wo wura Saulo nanabarima no.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content:
Wo ne wo mmammarima ne mo asomfoɔ na mobɛdɔ asase no, ayɛ so mfuo ama no, na wanya aduane ama ne fiefoɔ. Na Mefiboset deɛ, ɔne me bɛtena mʼahemfie ha.”
    Na Siba a na ɔwɔ mmammarima dunum ne asomfoɔ aduonu no buaa sɛ,

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: “Me wura pa, asɛm a woaka akyerɛ me no nyinaa, mɛdi so.” Na ɛfiri saa ɛberɛ no, Mefiboset ne Dawid didii daa te sɛ deɛ ɔyɛ nʼasene mu ba.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Na Mefiboset wɔ ɔba abarimaa bi a ne din de Mika. Na ɛfiri saa ɛberɛ no, Siba fiefoɔ nyinaa bɛyɛɛ Mefiboset asomfoɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13

content: Na Mefiboset a ɔyɛ obubuafoɔ no tu kɔɔ Yerusalem kɔtenaa ahemfie hɔ.

teaching.name: Samuel Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8:1-9:13
